def holdout_result(selected, metrics, settings):
    if selected is None:
        return NO_SELECTION
    return "확인" if passes(metrics, settings) else "미달"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Trace:
    """시나리오의 누적 최댓값이다. 값은 양자화한 판단값이다."""

    shift: float
    onset: object
    peaks: list
    times: list
    values: frozenset

    def first_alarm(self, threshold):
        index = bisect_left(self.peaks, threshold)
        return self.times[index] if index < len(self.peaks) else None


def trace_of(scenario, scores, window):
    peaks, times = [], []
    for index, score in enumerate(scores):
        if not peaks or score > peaks[-1]:
            peaks.append(score)
            times.append(index + window - 1)
    return Trace(scenario.shift, scenario.onset, peaks, times, frozenset(scores))


def threshold_candidates(traces):
    """고유값과 무경보 후보다. 누적 최댓값이 아닌 값은 바로 위 최댓값과 지표가 같고 더 작으므로 뽑히지 않는다."""
    unique = set().union(*(trace.values for trace in traces))
    silent = max(unique) + 1
    evaluated = set().union(*(trace.peaks for trace in traces)) | {silent}
    return sorted(evaluated), len(unique) + 1


def choose_threshold(traces, settings):
    evaluated, count = threshold_candidates(traces)
    rows = []
    for threshold in evaluated:
        outcomes = [(trace.shift, trace.onset, trace.first_alarm(threshold)) for trace in traces]
        rows.append((threshold, measure_alarms(outcomes, settings.length, settings.window)))
    return select_threshold(rows, settings), count


def mean_scores(scenario):
    return [quantize(row[0]) for row in scenario.features]


def logistic_scores(scenario, model):
    return [quantize(sigmoid(model.z(row))) for row in scenario.features]


def rule_outcomes(scenarios, settings):
    """비교 대상은 명세의 3:2로 고정한다. 생성 설정이 참조하는 설비 규칙을 따르지 않는다."""
    start = settings.window - 1
    return [(scenario.shift, scenario.onset, first_rule_alarm(scenario.fails, RULE_WINDOW, RULE_FAILS, start))
            for scenario in scenarios]


def replay_range(onset, alarm, window, length):
    """재생 구간이다. 경보가 없으면 onset + 20까지다. 경보가 onset − 5보다 앞서면 경보 행 하나만 남는다."""
    if alarm is None:
        return max(window - 1, onset - 5), min(onset + 20, length - 1)
    return max(window - 1, min(onset - 5, alarm)), alarm


def replay_status(onset, alarm, threshold):
    if threshold is None:
        return NO_THRESHOLD
    if alarm is None:
        return "missed"
    return "early" if alarm < onset else "detected"


def replay_rows(scenario, model, threshold, settings):
    window = settings.window
    scores = logistic_scores(scenario, model)
    alarm = None
    if threshold is not None:
        alarm = trace_of(scenario, scores, window).first_alarm(threshold)
    start, end = replay_range(scenario.onset, alarm, window, settings.length)
    status = replay_status(scenario.onset, alarm, threshold)
    rows = []
    for t in range(start, end + 1):
        raw = scenario.features[t - window + 1]
        scaled = standardize(raw, model.means, model.scales)
        z = linear_score(scaled, model.weights, model.bias)
        row = {"seed": scenario.seed, "method": "logistic", "onset": scenario.onset, "status": status, "t": t,
               "value": scenario.values[t], "window_values": " ".join(scenario.values[t - window + 1:t + 1]),
               "ewma_prev": "%.10f" % (scenario.ewma[t - 1] if t else 0.0), "z": "%.10f" % z,
               "p": "%.10f" % sigmoid(z)}
        row.update({name: "%.10f" % value for name, value in zip(FEATURES, raw)})
        row.update({"s_" + name: "%.10f" % value for name, value in zip(FEATURES, scaled)})
        row["threshold"] = "" if threshold is None else _threshold_text(threshold)
        row["alarm"] = "" if threshold is None else int(alarm == t)
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


def _threshold_text(threshold):
    return str((Decimal(threshold) / SCALE).quantize(Decimal("0.0001")))


def show(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    number = Decimal(value.numerator) / Decimal(value.denominator)
    return str(number.quantize(Decimal("0.0001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def _blank(columns, section, **fields):
    row = {column: "" for column in columns}
    row["section"] = section
    row.update(fields)
    return row


def metric_row(section, method, metrics, threshold="", candidates=""):
    return _blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, section, method=method, threshold=threshold, candidates=candidates,
                  detection_rate=show(metrics.detection_rate), early=metrics.early, missed=metrics.missed,
                  mean_delay_cost=show(metrics.mean_cost), mean_detected_delay=show(metrics.mean_detected),
                  false_per_1000=show(metrics.false_per_1000))


def shift_rows(section, method, metrics):
    return [_blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, section, method=method, shift=shift, detection_rate=show(metrics.shift_rate(shift)))
            for shift in sorted(metrics.by_shift)]


def policy_row(method, metrics, threshold, settings):
    minutes = metrics.stop_minutes_per_1000 * Fraction(str(settings.repair_minutes))
    return _blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, "policy", method=method, threshold=threshold,
                  suspect_output=show(metrics.suspect_output), false_stops=show(metrics.false_per_1000),
                  stop_minutes=show(minutes))


def evaluate(scenarios, score, threshold, settings):
    traces = [trace_of(scenario, score(scenario), settings.window) for scenario in scenarios]
    outcomes = [(trace.shift, trace.onset, trace.first_alarm(threshold)) for trace in traces]
    return measure_alarms(outcomes, settings.length, settings.window)


def compare(splits, model, settings):
    """검증에서 임계값과 방법을 고르고, 홀드아웃은 확인만 한다."""
    validation, holdout = splits["validation"], splits["holdout"]
    length, window = settings.length, settings.window
    scorers = {"moving_average": mean_scores, "logistic": lambda scenario: logistic_scores(scenario, model)}
    chosen = {"rule_3_2": (None, measure_alarms(rule_outcomes(validation, settings), length, window))}
    counts = {}
    for name, score in scorers.items():
        traces = [trace_of(scenario, score(scenario), window) for scenario in validation]
        best, counts[name] = choose_threshold(traces, settings)
        chosen[name] = best
    rows = [_blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, "notice", value=NOTICE)]
    final = {"rule_3_2": measure_alarms(rule_outcomes(holdout, settings), length, window)}
    for name, score in scorers.items():
        final[name] = None if chosen[name] is None else evaluate(holdout, score, chosen[name][0], settings)
    candidates = [(name, chosen[name][1] if chosen[name] else None) for name in METHODS]
    selected = select_method(candidates, settings)
    for section, table in (("validation", dict(candidates)), ("holdout", final)):
        for name in METHODS:
            metrics = table[name]
            threshold = _threshold_text(chosen[name][0]) if name in counts and chosen[name] else ""
            if metrics is None:
                rows.append(_blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, section, method=name, candidates=counts[name],
                                   value=NO_THRESHOLD))
            else:
                rows.append(metric_row(section, name, metrics, threshold,
                                       counts.get(name, "") if section == "validation" else ""))
        for name in METHODS:
            if table[name] is not None:
                rows.extend(shift_rows(section + "_shift", name, table[name]))
    for name in METHODS:
        if final[name] is not None:
            threshold = _threshold_text(chosen[name][0]) if name in counts else ""
            rows.append(policy_row(name, final[name], threshold, settings))
    outcome = holdout_result(selected, final.get(selected), settings)
    rows.append(_blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, "selection", method=selected or "", value=selected or NO_METHOD))
    rows.append(_blank(METHOD_COLUMNS, "selection", method=selected or "", value="홀드아웃 " + outcome))
    logistic = chosen["logistic"]
    return rows, selected, outcome, logistic[0] if logistic else None, counts


def model_rows(settings, model, threshold, counts):
    rows = []
    for name, value in (("generator", settings.generator.name), ("inspection", settings.inspection),
                        ("window", settings.window), ("ewma_lambda", settings.ewma_lambda)):
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "setting", name=name, value=value))
    for name in SPLITS:
        seeds = settings.splits[name]
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "split", name=name, value="%d-%d" % (seeds.start, seeds.stop - 1)))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "windows", name="positive", value=model.positive))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "windows", name="negative", value=model.negative))
    for name, mean, scale, weight in zip(FEATURES, model.means, model.scales, model.weights):
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "mean", name=name, value=repr(mean)))
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "scale", name=name, value=repr(scale)))
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "weight", name=name, value=repr(weight)))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "bias", name="bias", value=repr(model.bias)))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "fit", name="gradient_norm", value=repr(model.norm)))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "fit", name="status", value="수렴 미달" if model.norm > GRADIENT_LIMIT else "수렴"))
    rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "threshold", name="logistic",
                       value="" if threshold is None else _threshold_text(threshold)))
    for name, count in counts.items():
        rows.append(_blank(MODEL_COLUMNS, "candidates", name=name, value=count))
    return rows


def _write_csv(path, columns, rows):
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=columns)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def run(path):
    path = Path(path)
    settings = load_settings(path)
    process = load_process(settings)
    splits = {name: build_split(settings.splits[name], settings, process) for name in SPLITS}
    model = fit_model(splits["train"], settings)
    rows, selected, outcome, threshold, counts = compare(splits, model, settings)
    replay = replay_rows(splits["holdout"][1], model, threshold, settings)
    directory = Path("reports")
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stem = path.stem
    written = [directory / (stem + suffix) for suffix in ("_methods.csv", "_model.csv", "_replay.csv")]
    _write_csv(written[0], METHOD_COLUMNS, rows)
    _write_csv(written[1], MODEL_COLUMNS, model_rows(settings, model, threshold, counts))
    _write_csv(written[2], REPLAY_COLUMNS, replay)
    return rows, selected, outcome, written


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("config", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        rows, selected, outcome, written = run(args.config)
    except AnomalyError as error:
        parser.exit(3, "이상 검출 입력 오류:\n" + "\n".join(error.errors) + "\n")
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, csv.Error, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
        parser.exit(2, "오류: " + str(error) + "\n")
    print(NOTICE)

def _manual_fit(line, balance):
    by_id = {element.id: element for element in line.elements}
    for members in balance.stations:
        items = [by_id[name] for name in members]
        if items[0].inspection:
            continue
        for model in items[0].times:
            if not fits(sum(item.times.get(model, 0) for item in items), line.net, line.demand):
                return False
    return True

def run(path, seed_text, holdout_text, products):
    path = Path(path)
    if products < 1:
        raise ValueError("products는 양의 정수여야 함")
    seeds, holdout = parse_seeds(seed_text), parse_seeds(holdout_text)
    if set(seeds) & set(holdout):
        raise ValueError("--seeds와 --holdout-seeds는 겹칠 수 없음")
    raw = read_line_file(path)
    config, _, recipe, book = load_setup(path.parent / raw["generator"])
    if "process_cpk" not in config:
        raise ValueError("generator는 측정 설정이어야 함")
    line = load_line(path, recipe.models)
    weights = {model: Fraction(str(value)) for model, value in config["model_weights"].items()}
    ratios = {model: value / sum(weights.values()) for model, value in weights.items()}
    heuristic = heuristic_balance(line.elements, ratios, line.net, line.demand)
    optimal = optimal_balance(line.elements, ratios, line.net, line.demand)
    stem = path.stem
    directory = Path("reports")
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if optimal is None:
        _write_csv(directory / (stem + "_balance.csv"), BALANCE_COLUMNS,
                   balance_rows(line, ratios, heuristic, None, {}, Fraction(0)))
        _write_csv(directory / (stem + "_compare.csv"), COMPARE_COLUMNS,
                   [_row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "notice", value=COMPARE_NOTICE),
                    _row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "selection", value=NO_BALANCE)])
        return NO_BALANCE, None, [directory / (stem + "_balance.csv"), directory / (stem + "_compare.csv")]
    dev_routes = [product_routes(config, recipe, book, seed, products) for seed in seeds]
    holdout_routes = [product_routes(config, recipe, book, seed, products) for seed in holdout]
    routes = [route for run_routes in dev_routes for route in run_routes]
    visits = {name: Fraction(sum(route.attempts.get(name, 0) for route in routes), len(routes)) for name in line.machines}
    good_rate = Fraction(sum(route.good for route in routes), len(routes))
    rows, selected, results, candidates = compare(line, optimal, seed_text, holdout_text, products, dev_routes,
                                                  holdout_routes)
    _write_csv(directory / (stem + "_balance.csv"), BALANCE_COLUMNS,
               balance_rows(line, ratios, heuristic, optimal, visits, good_rate))
    _write_csv(directory / (stem + "_compare.csv"), COMPARE_COLUMNS, rows)
    if selected is None:
        key = min(candidates)[2]
        title = "기준 미달 조합 " + "-".join(map(str, key))
    else:
        key = selected
        title = "선택 조합 " + "-".join(map(str, key))
    combo, _, _, layout, _ = results[key]
    if not layout["meets_floor"]:
        title += " (바닥 제약 초과)"
    with (directory / (stem + "_layout.svg")).open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        target.write(render_svg(line, layout, combo, title))
    paths = [directory / (stem + suffix) for suffix in ("_balance.csv", "_compare.csv", "_layout.svg")]
    return ("선택" if selected else NO_COMBO), rows, paths

def write_outputs(stem, report):
    directory = Path("reports")
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = directory / (stem + "_report.csv")
    with csv_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=REPORT_COLUMNS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(report)
    markdown_path = directory / (stem + "_report.md")
    with markdown_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        target.write(build_markdown(report))
    return csv_path, markdown_path


def run(table_path, config_path, seed_text, products, root=ROOT):
    if products < 1:
        raise ValueError("products는 양의 정수여야 함")
    seeds = parse_seeds(seed_text)
    config, content, recipe, book = load_setup(config_path)
    if "process_cpk" not in config:
        raise ValueError("--config는 측정 설정이어야 함")
    rows = read_table(table_path)
    references = check_table(rows, recipe.models, root)
    source = dict(generator_version=generator_version(config), config_sha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),
                  recipe_sha256=recipe.sha256, equipment_sha256=book.sha256, seeds=seed_text, products=products)
    alternatives = []
    metrics, detail = None, None
    for condition, probability in ALTERNATIVES:
        changed = config if probability is None else dict(config, retest_probability=probability)
        counts, equipment = collect(changed, recipe, book, seeds, products)
        if probability is None:
            metrics, detail = counts, equipment
        alternatives.append((condition, counts))
    return build_report(rows, references, metrics, detail, alternatives, source)

def run(path, seed, products, names):
    """시나리오를 돌리고, 전부 끝까지 성공했을 때만 보고서를 쓴다."""
    if products < 1:
        raise ValueError("products는 양의 정수여야 함")
    station = load_station(path)
    values, item = load_values(station, seed, products)
    outcomes = {name: run_scenario(station, name, values, item) for name in names}
    directory = Path("reports")
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    written = []
    for name, outcome in outcomes.items():
        stem = "plc_station_" + name
        _write_csv(directory / (stem + ".csv"), RECORD_COLUMNS, outcome.records)
        _write_csv(directory / (stem + "_modbus.csv"), MODBUS_COLUMNS, outcome.frames)
        written.extend((directory / (stem + ".csv"), directory / (stem + "_modbus.csv")))
    return outcomes, written

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    parser.add_argument("--products", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--scenario", default="normal", help="시나리오 이름 또는 all")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    names = list(SCENARIOS) if args.scenario == "all" else [args.scenario]
    if any(name not in SCENARIOS for name in names):
        parser.exit(2, "오류: 없는 시나리오 " + args.scenario + "\n")

        outcomes, written = run(args.station, args.seed, args.products, names)
    except StationError as error:
        parser.exit(3, "스테이션 입력 오류:\n" + "\n".join(error.errors) + "\n")
    except ModbusTimeout as error:
        parser.exit(2, "오류: " + str(error) + ". 결과를 믿을 수 없어 보고서를 쓰지 않음\n")

        parser.exit(2, "오류: " + str(error) + "\n")
    print("Python 기반 PLC 스캔 모의. 실제 PLC·설비가 아니다.")

                                   outcome.heartbeat_scan))))
    print("저장 파일: " + ", ".join(path.as_posix() for path in written))
    return 0

class StubRandom:
    """gauss는 평균을 그대로 돌려주고, random은 주어진 값을 돌려준다."""

    def __init__(self, draw=1.0):
        self.draw = draw

    def random(self):
        return self.draw

    def gauss(self, mean, _):
        return mean

class SeriesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_t172_measure_values(self):
        cases = [(1.0, 0, "10.000"), (1.0, 2.5, "11.880"), (0.0, 0, "13.759"), (0.0, 2.5, "15.639")]
        for draw, shift, expected in cases:
            self.assertEqual(measure(StubRandom(draw), PROCESS, shift), expected)

    def test_t172_onset_boundary(self):
        original = random.Random
        try:
            random.Random = lambda seed: type("R", (StubRandom,), {"randint": lambda self, low, high: 150})(1.0)
            scenario = build_scenario(1, 2.5, SETTINGS, PROCESS)
        finally:
            random.Random = original
        self.assertEqual(scenario.onset, 150)
        self.assertEqual(scenario.values[149], "10.000")
        self.assertEqual(scenario.values[150], "11.880")

    def test_t173_repeatable_and_assigned(self):
        self.assertEqual(build_scenario(5, 1.5, SETTINGS, PROCESS).values, build_scenario(5, 1.5, SETTINGS, PROCESS).values)
        shifts = (1.0, 1.5, 2.5)
        self.assertEqual([assignment(index, shifts) for index in (0, 1, 3, 5, 7)], [0, 1.0, 1.5, 2.5, 1.0])
        counts = [assignment(index, shifts) for index in range(300)]
        self.assertEqual(counts.count(0), 150)
        self.assertEqual([counts.count(shift) for shift in shifts], [50, 50, 50])

    def test_normal_scenario_also_draws_defects_and_no_onset(self):
        scenario = build_scenario(0, 0, SETTINGS, PROCESS)
        self.assertIsNone(scenario.onset)
        self.assertEqual(len(scenario.values), 400)
        self.assertEqual(len(scenario.features), 391)

    def test_t174_features(self):
        x = [0.0] * 9 + [10.0]
        fails = [False] * 9 + [True]
        mean, sd, maximum, slope, ewma, share = window_features(x, fails, ewma_of(x, 0.2), 10, 9)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean, 1.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(maximum, 10.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sd, math.sqrt(10))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(slope, 6 / 11)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(share, 0.1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(ewma, 2.0)

    def test_t174_ewma_recursion(self):
        self.assertEqual(ewma_of([1.0, 1.0], 0.5), [0.5, 0.75])

    def test_t175_features_ignore_later_values(self):
        x = [float(index % 7) for index in range(30)]
        fails = [index % 5 == 0 for index in range(30)]
        before = window_features(x, fails, ewma_of(x, 0.2), 10, 15)
        changed = x[:16] + [99.0] * 14
        after = window_features(changed, fails[:16] + [True] * 14, ewma_of(changed, 0.2), 10, 15)
        self.assertEqual(before, after)

    def test_t177_validation_change_reaches_evaluation_but_not_the_model(self):
        moved = {"train": {"seed_start": 0, "count": 12}, "validation": {"seed_start": 300, "count": 12},
                 "holdout": {"seed_start": 200, "count": 12}}
        reports = []
        for changes in ({}, {"splits": moved}):
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                self.assertEqual(run_cli(small_config(folder, **changes), cwd=folder).returncode, 0)
                directory = Path(folder) / "reports"
                with (directory / "anomaly_model.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
                    model = [row for row in csv.DictReader(source)
                             if row["section"] in ("mean", "scale", "weight", "bias", "windows")]
                with (directory / "anomaly_methods.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
                    validation = [row for row in csv.DictReader(source) if row["section"] == "validation"]
                reports.append((model, validation))
        self.assertEqual(reports[0][0], reports[1][0])
        self.assertNotEqual(reports[0][1], reports[1][1])

    def test_t177_zero_variance_divides_by_one(self):
        means, scales = standardizer([(1.0, 5.0), (3.0, 5.0)])
        self.assertEqual(means, [2.0, 5.0])
        self.assertEqual(scales, [1.0, 1.0])

검수일: 2026-10-31. **VERDICT: FIX. 이전 H1·H2·M1은 해결. 신규 미해결 높음 1건(H3)·중간 1건(M2), 수정 요구 2건. 낮음 지적 없음.** 이번 반례 14개 중 11개 통과·3개 실패다. 전체 테스트 지정 명령은 한 번만 직접 실행했으나 `py` 런처가 Python을 찾지 못해 시작되지 않았다. 전체 테스트 통과 여부는 **미검증**이다.

## 범위와 수행

기준은 `handoff/tasks.md:1` 현행 8단계 명세·T113–T129 및 아래 완료 단계의 보존 조건이다. `handoff/setup-notes.md`, `handoff/tasks.md`, `handoff/gpt-log.md`의 관련 구현·014 수정 기록, `handoff/decisions.md`, 이전 `014-review.md`, 최근 이력·diff와 실제 코드·테스트·제출물을 대조했다. 과거 `docs/` 명세를 검수 기준으로 사용하지 않았다. 새 산출물인 점수 기준표는 현행 명세에 대한 구현물로만 확인했다.

`practical-work-operation`을 범위·보존·검증 조율에 적용했다. 사용자 지시에 따라 플러그인 리뷰 스킬·보조 에이전트·이전 반례 파일 전체 실행을 사용하지 않았다. 이번에 작성한 파일은 `handoff/reviews/015-review.md`, `handoff/reviews/probes/test_probe_015.py`뿐이다. 제품 코드·기존 테스트를 수정하거나 커밋·푸시·설치·삭제하지 않았다. 시작부터 있던 미추적 `handoff/loop-logs/015-codex.txt`는 건드리지 않았다. 모든 재생 산출물은 반례 내부 임시 폴더에만 썼다.

검토 명령:

```text
git diff 3d3b2fd83a69b667b1d22ba9856015ed2aea5879..HEAD
git log -6 --oneline
git log --format='%h %s' 3d3b2fd..HEAD
git diff --check 3d3b2fd83a69b667b1d22ba9856015ed2aea5879..HEAD
```

HEAD: `96374f210743bb004748ffbc37cacfc58c56ff1b`. 지정 범위는 14파일이다. diff 검사는 출력 없이 종료 0. 범위 내 커밋:

96374f2 feat(T113-T129): add synthetic PFMEA practice with evidence links

+def confirm_value(number):
+    """생성값을 CSV에 쓸 문자열로 확정한다. 이후 분기는 이 문자열만 쓴다."""
+    if not math.isfinite(number):
+        raise ValueError("측정값이 유한하지 않음")
+    exact = Decimal(repr(number))
+    # 양자화는 정밀도를 넘으면 InvalidOperation이므로 정수부 자릿수를 먼저 본다.
+    if exact.adjusted() >= MAX_DECIMAL_DIGITS:
+        raise ValueError("측정값이 value 자릿수 상한을 넘음: " + repr(number))
+    with localcontext() as context:
+        context.prec = 100
+        rounded = exact.quantize(Decimal("0.001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+        text = "0.000" if rounded == 0 else format(rounded, "f")
+    if not is_decimal_text(text):
+        raise ValueError("측정값이 value 자릿수 상한을 넘음: " + text)
+    return text

+        for item in model.inspections:
+            if item.lsl is None or item.usl is None:
+                raise ValueError("측정 생성은 양측 규격만 지원함: " + item.id)
+            lsl, usl = float(item.lsl), float(item.usl)
+            try:
+                divisor = 6 * config["process_cpk"]
+                sigma = (usl - lsl) / divisor if divisor else math.inf
+                finite = math.isfinite(sigma) and math.isfinite((lsl + usl) / 2 + shift * sigma)
+            except OverflowError:
+                finite = False
+            if not finite:
+                raise ValueError("규격과 process_cpk로 계산한 분포가 유한하지 않음: " + item.id)
+    return True

"""설비별 최초 측정의 Cpk·Ppk 계산과 보고서."""

import csv
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, localcontext
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from .summary import ASSUMPTION_NOTICE


SUBGROUP_SIZE = 5
D2 = Decimal("2.326")
MIN_SUBGROUPS = 25
MIN_CPK_SUBGROUPS = 2
PRECISION = 100
LOW_SAMPLE = "표본 부족"
NO_VARIATION = "변동 없음"
COMPUTED = "계산됨"
CAPABILITY_NOTICE = ASSUMPTION_NOTICE + " 구간을 합친 값이며 안정 공정의 능력을 보증하지 않는다."
CAPABILITY_COLUMNS = (
    "section", "inspection", "equipment", "unit", "lsl", "usl", "n", "subgroups", "xbarbar", "rbar",
    "sigma_within", "cpk", "sample_sd", "ppk", "status", "value",
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Capability:
    n: int
    subgroups: int
    xbarbar: Optional[Decimal]
    rbar: Optional[Decimal]
    sigma_within: Optional[Decimal]
    cpk: Optional[Decimal]
    sample_sd: Optional[Decimal]
    ppk: Optional[Decimal]


def _margin(center, lsl, usl):
    """가까운 규격까지의 부호 있는 거리다. 단측이면 있는 쪽만 본다."""
    sides = []
    if usl is not None:
        sides.append(usl - center)
    if lsl is not None:
        sides.append(center - lsl)
    return min(sides)


def capability(segments, lsl, usl):
    """구간별 측정값을 받는다. 계산할 수 없는 항목은 None이고 표본 기준은 여기서 보지 않는다."""
    lsl = None if lsl is None else Decimal(lsl)
    usl = None if usl is None else Decimal(usl)
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = PRECISION
        values = [Decimal(value) for segment in segments for value in segment]
        groups = []
        for segment in segments:
            whole = len(segment) - len(segment) % SUBGROUP_SIZE
            groups += [[Decimal(value) for value in segment[index:index + SUBGROUP_SIZE]]
                       for index in range(0, whole, SUBGROUP_SIZE)]
        xbarbar = rbar = sigma_within = cpk = sample_sd = ppk = None
        if groups:
            xbarbar = sum(sum(group) / len(group) for group in groups) / len(groups)
            rbar = sum(max(group) - min(group) for group in groups) / len(groups)
            sigma_within = rbar / D2
        if len(groups) >= MIN_CPK_SUBGROUPS and sigma_within > 0:
            cpk = _margin(xbarbar, lsl, usl) / (3 * sigma_within)
        if len(values) >= 2:
            mean = sum(values) / len(values)
            sample_sd = (sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in values) / (len(values) - 1)).sqrt()
            if sample_sd > 0:
                ppk = _margin(mean, lsl, usl) / (3 * sample_sd)
    return Capability(len(values), len(groups), xbarbar, rbar, sigma_within, cpk, sample_sd, ppk)


def show(value):
    """계산값을 보고 문자열로 바꾼다. None은 빈칸이고 음수 영은 쓰지 않는다."""
    if value is None:
        return ""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = PRECISION
        rounded = value.quantize(Decimal("0.0001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        return "0.0000" if rounded == 0 else format(rounded, "f")


def status_of(result):
    if result.subgroups < MIN_SUBGROUPS:
        return LOW_SAMPLE
    if result.sigma_within == 0 or not result.sample_sd:
        return NO_VARIATION
    return COMPUTED


def equipment_segments(analysis, equipment):
    """허용된 재가동에서 물리적 행 순서를 끊는다. 재검사와 거절 행은 넣지 않는다."""
    cuts = [restart.row_index for restart in analysis.restarts if restart.equipment == equipment]
    segments = [[] for _ in range(len(cuts) + 1)]
    for record in analysis.first_inspections:
        if record.equipment == equipment:
            segments[sum(cut < record.row_index for cut in cuts)].append(record.value)
    return segments


def _row(section, **fields):
    return {column: fields.get(column, section if column == "section" else "") for column in CAPABILITY_COLUMNS}


def build_capability(analysis):
    process = analysis.process
    specs = {item.id: item for model in process.models.values() for item in model.inspections}
    book = process.equipment_book
    rows = [_row("notice", value=CAPABILITY_NOTICE)]
    for equipment, inspection in sorted(book.equipment.items(), key=lambda pair: (pair[1], pair[0])):
        item = specs[inspection]
        result = capability(equipment_segments(analysis, equipment), item.lsl, item.usl)
        status = status_of(result)
        hidden = status == LOW_SAMPLE
        rows.append(_row(
            "capability", inspection=inspection, equipment=equipment, unit=item.unit, lsl=item.lsl or "",
            usl=item.usl or "", n=result.n, subgroups=result.subgroups, xbarbar=show(result.xbarbar),
            rbar=show(result.rbar), sigma_within=show(result.sigma_within), cpk="" if hidden else show(result.cpk),
            sample_sd=show(result.sample_sd), ppk="" if hidden else show(result.ppk), status=status,
        ))
    return rows


def write_capability(stem, rows):
    path = Path("reports") / (str(stem) + "_capability.csv")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=CAPABILITY_COLUMNS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    return path


def print_capability(rows, path):
    print("[공정능력]")
    print(rows[0]["value"])
    print("inspection | equipment | n | subgroups | cpk | ppk | status")
    for row in rows[1:]:
        print(" | ".join(str(row[column]) for column in
                         ("inspection", "equipment", "n", "subgroups", "cpk", "ppk", "status")))
    print()
    print("저장 파일: " + path.as_posix())

"""LEAK 검사 스테이션 한 곳의 시퀀스를 스캔 주기 상태 기계로 모의한다. 실제 PLC 프로그램이 아니다."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Mapping

from src.modbus import (
    HEARTBEAT_REGISTER, JUDGE_REGISTER, RELEASE_COIL, RESET_COIL, Table, ValueConversionError, to_words,
)


IDLE, CHECK, CLAMP, MEASURE, PUBLISH, WAIT_JUDGE, UNCLAMP, DISCHARGE, ALARM = range(9)
STATE_NAMES = ("IDLE", "CHECK", "CLAMP", "MEASURE", "PUBLISH", "WAIT_JUDGE", "UNCLAMP", "DISCHARGE", "ALARM")

INPUTS = ("part_present", "seated", "direction_ok", "clamp_closed", "clamp_open", "guard_closed", "measure_done")
OUTPUTS = ("clamp_cmd", "measure_cmd", "gate_ok", "gate_ng", "alarm_lamp")

ALARM_CHECK = 11
ALARM_CLAMP = 12
ALARM_MEASURE = 13
ALARM_JUDGE = 14
ALARM_UNCLAMP = 15
ALARM_DISCHARGE = 16
ALARM_HEARTBEAT = 21
ALARM_GUARD = 22
ALARM_CONVERSION = 23
ALARM_CLAMP_CONFLICT = 24
ALARM_MEASURE_SIGNAL = 25

TIMEOUT_ALARMS = {
    CHECK: ("check_scans", ALARM_CHECK),
    CLAMP: ("clamp_scans", ALARM_CLAMP),
    MEASURE: ("measure_scans", ALARM_MEASURE),
    WAIT_JUDGE: ("judge_scans", ALARM_JUDGE),
    UNCLAMP: ("unclamp_scans", ALARM_UNCLAMP),
    DISCHARGE: ("discharge_scans", ALARM_DISCHARGE),
}

REG_STATE, REG_ALARM, REG_MEASURE_ID, REG_VALUE_HIGH, REG_VALUE_LOW, REG_HEARTBEAT, REG_COUNT = range(7)
JUDGE_PASS = 1
JUDGE_FAIL = 2


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Timing:
    heartbeat_scans: int
    timeouts: Mapping[str, int]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Snapshot:
    """스캔 시작 때 복사한 값이다. 스캔 중에는 이 값만 본다."""

    inputs: Mapping[str, bool]
    value: str
    reset: bool
    release: bool
    heartbeat: int
    judge: tuple


def interlock(requested, previous, inputs, state):
    """기본 출력에 인터록을 적용한다. 출력 갱신의 마지막 단계다."""
    outputs = dict(requested)
    if outputs["clamp_cmd"] and not previous["clamp_cmd"] and not (
            inputs["seated"] and inputs["direction_ok"] and inputs["guard_closed"]):
        outputs["clamp_cmd"] = False
    if outputs["measure_cmd"] and not (
            inputs["clamp_closed"] and not inputs["clamp_open"] and inputs["guard_closed"]):
        outputs["measure_cmd"] = False
    if outputs["gate_ok"] and outputs["gate_ng"]:
        outputs["gate_ok"] = outputs["gate_ng"] = False
    if not inputs["clamp_open"] or inputs["clamp_closed"]:
        outputs["gate_ok"] = outputs["gate_ng"] = False
    if state == ALARM:
        outputs["measure_cmd"] = outputs["gate_ok"] = outputs["gate_ng"] = False
    return outputs


class Plc:
    """주소표를 입출력으로 삼아 스캔을 돈다. `scan` 한 번이 스캔 하나다."""

    def __init__(self, table: Table, timing: Timing):
        self.table = table
        self.timing = timing
        self.scan_number = 0
        self.state = IDLE
        self.counter = 0
        self.alarm = 0
        self.outputs = {name: False for name in OUTPUTS}
        self.previous_reset = False
        self.previous_release = False
        self.previous_heartbeat = 0
        self.heartbeat_scan = 0
        self.release_latch = False
        self.measure_id = 0
        self.value = ""
        self.verdict = 0
        self.rejected = None
        self.processed = 0
        self.ok_count = 0
        self.ng_count = 0
        self.events = []

    def _snapshot(self, value):
        with self.table.lock:
            return Snapshot(
                dict(zip(INPUTS, self.table.discrete)), value, self.table.coils[RESET_COIL],
                self.table.coils[RELEASE_COIL], self.table.holding[HEARTBEAT_REGISTER],
                tuple(self.table.holding[JUDGE_REGISTER:JUDGE_REGISTER + 2]))

    def _go(self, state):
        self.state = state
        self.counter = 0
        return True

    def _raise(self, code):
        self.alarm = code
        self.events.append("알람 %d" % code)
        return self._go(ALARM)

    def _heartbeat_late(self):
        return self.scan_number - self.heartbeat_scan > self.timing.heartbeat_scans

    def _measure_ready(self, snap):
        return (self.outputs["measure_cmd"] and snap.inputs["clamp_closed"] and not snap.inputs["clamp_open"])

    def _immediate_alarm(self, snap):
        inputs = snap.inputs
        if not inputs["guard_closed"]:
            return ALARM_GUARD
        if self._heartbeat_late():
            return ALARM_HEARTBEAT
        if inputs["clamp_closed"] and inputs["clamp_open"]:
            return ALARM_CLAMP_CONFLICT
        if self.state in (CHECK, CLAMP) and inputs["measure_done"]:
            return ALARM_MEASURE_SIGNAL
        if self.state == MEASURE and inputs["measure_done"] and not self._measure_ready(snap):
            return ALARM_MEASURE_SIGNAL
        return 0

    def _publish(self):
        """변환이 성공하면 판정 지우기, 측정값 기록, ID 증가를 한 번에 한다."""
        try:
            high, low = to_words(self.value)
        except ValueConversionError:
            return self._raise(ALARM_CONVERSION)
        self.measure_id = self.measure_id % 65535 + 1
        with self.table.lock:
            self.table.holding[JUDGE_REGISTER:JUDGE_REGISTER + 2] = [0, 0]
            self.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_HIGH] = high
            self.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_LOW] = low
        self.rejected = None
        return self._go(WAIT_JUDGE)

    def _judge(self, snap):
        pair = snap.judge
        if pair == (0, 0):
            return False
        if pair[0] == self.measure_id and pair[1] in (JUDGE_PASS, JUDGE_FAIL):
            self.verdict = pair[1]
            self.events.append("판정 접수")
            return self._go(UNCLAMP)
        if pair != self.rejected:
            self.rejected = pair
            reason = "ID 불일치" if pair[0] != self.measure_id else "판정 값 오류"
            self.events.append("판정 거절: " + reason)
        return False

    def _discharged(self):
        self.processed = (self.processed + 1) % 65536
        if self.verdict == JUDGE_PASS:
            self.ok_count += 1
        else:
            self.ng_count += 1
        self.verdict = 0
        self.value = ""
        return self._go(IDLE)

    def _recoverable(self, snap):
        inputs = snap.inputs
        return (inputs["guard_closed"] and not self._heartbeat_late() and inputs["clamp_open"]
                and not inputs["clamp_closed"] and not inputs["part_present"])

    def _recover(self):
        self.alarm = 0
        self.value = ""
        self.verdict = 0
        self.release_latch = False
        self.events.append("aborted")
        with self.table.lock:
            self.table.holding[JUDGE_REGISTER:JUDGE_REGISTER + 2] = [0, 0]
            self.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_HIGH] = 0
            self.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_LOW] = 0
        return self._go(IDLE)

    def _transition(self, snap, reset_edge):
        inputs = snap.inputs
        state = self.state
        if state == IDLE:
            return inputs["part_present"] and not inputs["measure_done"] and self._go(CHECK)
        if state == CHECK:
            return inputs["seated"] and inputs["direction_ok"] and self._go(CLAMP)
        if state == CLAMP:
            return inputs["clamp_closed"] and self._go(MEASURE)
        if state == MEASURE:
            if inputs["measure_done"]:
                self.value = snap.value
                return self._go(PUBLISH)
            return False
        if state == PUBLISH:
            return self._publish()
        if state == WAIT_JUDGE:
            return self._judge(snap)
        if state == UNCLAMP:
            return inputs["clamp_open"] and self._go(DISCHARGE)
        if state == DISCHARGE:
            return not inputs["part_present"] and self._discharged()
        return reset_edge and self._recoverable(snap) and self._recover()

    def _timeout(self):
        if self.state not in TIMEOUT_ALARMS:
            return
        key, code = TIMEOUT_ALARMS[self.state]
        self.counter += 1
        if self.counter > self.timing.timeouts[key]:
            self._raise(code)

    def _requested(self):
        state = self.state
        outputs = {name: False for name in OUTPUTS}
        outputs["clamp_cmd"] = state in (CLAMP, MEASURE, PUBLISH, WAIT_JUDGE)
        outputs["measure_cmd"] = state == MEASURE
        outputs["gate_ok"] = state == DISCHARGE and self.verdict == JUDGE_PASS
        outputs["gate_ng"] = state == DISCHARGE and self.verdict == JUDGE_FAIL
        if state == ALARM:
            outputs["alarm_lamp"] = True
            outputs["clamp_cmd"] = self.outputs["clamp_cmd"] and not self.release_latch
        return outputs

    def _write(self):
        with self.table.lock:
            self.table.coils[:len(OUTPUTS)] = [self.outputs[name] for name in OUTPUTS]
            registers = self.table.input_registers
            registers[REG_STATE] = self.state
            registers[REG_ALARM] = self.alarm
            registers[REG_MEASURE_ID] = self.measure_id
            registers[REG_HEARTBEAT] = (registers[REG_HEARTBEAT] + 1) % 65536
            registers[REG_COUNT] = self.processed

    def scan(self, value="", after_snapshot=None):
        """스캔 하나를 돈다. after_snapshot은 스냅샷 격리를 확인하는 시험용 훅이다."""
        self.scan_number += 1
        self.events = []
        snap = self._snapshot(value)
        if after_snapshot is not None:
            after_snapshot()
        if snap.heartbeat != self.previous_heartbeat:
            self.previous_heartbeat = snap.heartbeat
            self.heartbeat_scan = self.scan_number
        reset_edge = snap.reset and not self.previous_reset
        release_edge = snap.release and not self.previous_release
        self.previous_reset, self.previous_release = snap.reset, snap.release
        if self.state == ALARM and release_edge:
            self.release_latch = True
        code = 0 if self.state == ALARM else self._immediate_alarm(snap)
        if code:
            self._raise(code)
        elif not self._transition(snap, reset_edge):
            self._timeout()
        self.outputs = interlock(self._requested(), self.outputs, snap.inputs, self.state)
        self._write()
        return self.state

"""소프트웨어 간 Modbus TCP를 표준 라이브러리 소켓으로 구현한다. 실제 PLC, 실제 네트워크 장비가 아니다."""

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, localcontext
import socket
import struct
import threading

from src.recipe import is_decimal_text


UNIT_ID = 1
ADDRESS_SPACE = 16
HEADER_BYTES = 6
MIN_LENGTH = 2
MAX_LENGTH = 254

READ_COILS = 0x01
READ_DISCRETE = 0x02
READ_HOLDING = 0x03
READ_INPUT = 0x04
WRITE_COIL = 0x05
WRITE_REGISTER = 0x06
WRITE_REGISTERS = 0x10
FUNCTIONS = (READ_COILS, READ_DISCRETE, READ_HOLDING, READ_INPUT, WRITE_COIL, WRITE_REGISTER, WRITE_REGISTERS)

ILLEGAL_FUNCTION = 1
ILLEGAL_ADDRESS = 2
ILLEGAL_VALUE = 3
DEVICE_FAILURE = 4

COIL_ON = 0xFF00
COIL_OFF = 0x0000
RESET_COIL = 8
RELEASE_COIL = 9
HEARTBEAT_REGISTER = 0
JUDGE_REGISTER = 1
JUDGE_REGISTERS = 2
WRITABLE_COILS = (RESET_COIL, RELEASE_COIL)

VALUE_SCALE = 1000
VALUE_MIN = -2147483648
VALUE_MAX = 2147483647


class ValueConversionError(ValueError):
    """측정값이 정수 천분율 32비트로 정확히 표현되지 않는다."""


class ModbusResponseError(ConnectionError):
    """응답이 요청과 맞지 않거나 연결이 끊겼다. 클라이언트는 연결을 닫는다."""


class ModbusTimeout(TimeoutError):
    """응답 제한 시간을 넘겼다."""


class ModbusException(Exception):
    """서버가 형식에 맞는 예외 응답을 돌려줬다. 연결은 유지된다."""

    def __init__(self, function, code):
        super().__init__("function 0x%02X exception %02d" % (function, code))
        self.function = function
        self.code = code


def to_words(text):
    """측정값 문자열을 상위·하위 워드로 바꾼다. 2의 보수이고 상위 워드가 앞선다."""
    if not is_decimal_text(text):
        raise ValueConversionError(str(text) + ": 소수 문자열이 아님")
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 60
        scaled = Decimal(text) * VALUE_SCALE
        if scaled != scaled.to_integral_value():
            raise ValueConversionError(text + ": 소수 셋째 자리를 넘음")
    number = int(scaled)
    if not VALUE_MIN <= number <= VALUE_MAX:
        raise ValueConversionError(text + ": 32비트 범위를 넘음")
    raw = number & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return raw >> 16, raw & 0xFFFF


def from_words(high, low):
    """워드를 부호 있는 정수로 합친다."""
    raw = high << 16 | low
    return raw - (1 << 32) if raw & 0x80000000 else raw


def restore_value(high, low):
    """워드를 소수 셋째 자리 문자열로 복원한다."""
    number = from_words(high, low)
    sign = "-" if number < 0 else ""
    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(number), VALUE_SCALE)
    return "%s%d.%03d" % (sign, whole, fraction)


class Table:
    """PLC, 모의 설비, 서버가 함께 쓰는 주소표다. 모든 접근은 lock 안에서 한다."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.coils = [False] * ADDRESS_SPACE
        self.discrete = [False] * ADDRESS_SPACE
        self.holding = [0] * ADDRESS_SPACE
        self.input_registers = [0] * ADDRESS_SPACE


def _words(*values):
    return struct.pack(">" + "H" * len(values), *values)


def _pack_bits(bits):
    packed = bytearray((len(bits) + 7) // 8)
    for index, bit in enumerate(bits):
        if bit:
            packed[index // 8] |= 1 << (index % 8)
    return bytes(packed)


def _unpack_bits(packed, count):
    return [bool(packed[index // 8] >> (index % 8) & 1) for index in range(count)]


def _exception(function, code):
    return bytes((function | 0x80, code))


def _read_error(pdu, limit):
    if len(pdu) != 5:
        return ILLEGAL_VALUE
    start, count = struct.unpack(">HH", pdu[1:5])
    if not 1 <= count <= limit:
        return ILLEGAL_VALUE
    if start + count > ADDRESS_SPACE:
        return ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
    return None


def _read_bits(pdu, bits):
    error = _read_error(pdu, 2000)
    if error:
        return _exception(pdu[0], error)
    start, count = struct.unpack(">HH", pdu[1:5])
    packed = _pack_bits(bits[start:start + count])
    return bytes((pdu[0], len(packed))) + packed


def _read_registers(pdu, registers):
    error = _read_error(pdu, 125)
    if error:
        return _exception(pdu[0], error)
    start, count = struct.unpack(">HH", pdu[1:5])
    return bytes((pdu[0], count * 2)) + _words(*registers[start:start + count])


def _write_coil(pdu, table):
    if len(pdu) != 5:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_VALUE)
    address, value = struct.unpack(">HH", pdu[1:5])
    if value not in (COIL_ON, COIL_OFF):
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_VALUE)
    if address not in WRITABLE_COILS:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_ADDRESS)
    table.coils[address] = value == COIL_ON
    return pdu


def _write_register(pdu, table):
    if len(pdu) != 5:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_VALUE)
    address, value = struct.unpack(">HH", pdu[1:5])
    if address != HEARTBEAT_REGISTER:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_ADDRESS)
    table.holding[address] = value
    return pdu


def _write_registers(pdu, table):
    if len(pdu) < 6:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_VALUE)
    start, count, size = struct.unpack(">HHB", pdu[1:6])
    if len(pdu) != 6 + size or size != count * 2 or not 1 <= count <= 123:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_VALUE)
    if start != JUDGE_REGISTER or count != JUDGE_REGISTERS:
        return _exception(pdu[0], ILLEGAL_ADDRESS)
    table.holding[start:start + count] = struct.unpack(">" + "H" * count, pdu[6:])
    return pdu[:5]


def handle_pdu(pdu, table):
    """요청 PDU 하나를 처리해 응답 PDU를 돌려준다. 검증이 끝나기 전에는 쓰지 않는다."""
    function = pdu[0]
    if function not in FUNCTIONS:
        return _exception(function, ILLEGAL_FUNCTION)
    try:
        with table.lock:
            if function == READ_COILS:
                return _read_bits(pdu, table.coils)
            if function == READ_DISCRETE:
                return _read_bits(pdu, table.discrete)
            if function == READ_HOLDING:
                return _read_registers(pdu, table.holding)
            if function == READ_INPUT:
                return _read_registers(pdu, table.input_registers)
            if function == WRITE_COIL:
                return _write_coil(pdu, table)
            if function == WRITE_REGISTER:
                return _write_register(pdu, table)
            return _write_registers(pdu, table)
    except Exception:
        return _exception(function, DEVICE_FAILURE)


class FrameBuffer:
    """길이 기반 수신 버퍼다. 분할·병합 수신을 모두 처리한다.

    손상을 만나도 앞의 완성 프레임은 돌려주고 damaged만 세운다. 호출자는 그 프레임을 처리한 뒤 닫는다.
    그래서 같은 바이트열의 결과가 수신 분할에 따라 달라지지 않는다.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.data = bytearray()
        self.damaged = False

    def feed(self, chunk):
        self.data.extend(chunk)
        frames = []
        while len(self.data) >= HEADER_BYTES:
            _, protocol, length = struct.unpack(">HHH", self.data[:HEADER_BYTES])
            if protocol != 0 or not MIN_LENGTH <= length <= MAX_LENGTH:
                self.damaged = True
                break
            total = HEADER_BYTES + length
            if len(self.data) < total:
                break
            frames.append(bytes(self.data[:total]))
            del self.data[:total]
        return frames


def respond(frame, table):
    """완성된 요청 프레임의 응답 프레임을 만든다. Unit ID가 다르면 None이다."""
    transaction, _, _, unit = struct.unpack(">HHHB", frame[:7])
    if unit != UNIT_ID:
        return None
    pdu = handle_pdu(frame[7:], table)
    return struct.pack(">HHHB", transaction, 0, len(pdu) + 1, unit) + pdu


class ModbusServer:
    """127.0.0.1의 임시 포트에서 연결을 하나씩 받는다."""

    def __init__(self, table):
        self.table = table
        self.listener = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        self.listener.listen()
        self.listener.settimeout(0.05)
        self.port = self.listener.getsockname()[1]
        self.stopping = threading.Event()
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._accept, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def _accept(self):
        while not self.stopping.is_set():
            try:
                connection, _ = self.listener.accept()
            except socket.timeout:
                continue
            except OSError:
                return
            with connection:
                connection.settimeout(None)
                connection.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY, 1)
                self._serve(connection)

    def _serve(self, connection):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        while True:
            try:
                chunk = connection.recv(4096)
            except OSError:
                return
            if not chunk:
                return
            for frame in buffer.feed(chunk):
                reply = respond(frame, self.table)
                if reply is not None:
                    try:
                        connection.sendall(reply)
                    except OSError:
                        return
            if buffer.damaged:
                return

    def close(self):
        self.stopping.set()
        self.thread.join(5)
        self.listener.close()


class ModbusClient:
    """요청을 보내고 응답을 기다린다. on_frame은 완성된 프레임을 방향·기능·16진수로 받는다."""

    def __init__(self, port, timeout=1.0, on_frame=None):
        self.socket = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=timeout)
        self.socket.settimeout(timeout)
        self.socket.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY, 1)
        self.buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.transaction = 0
        self.on_frame = on_frame or (lambda direction, function, text: None)
        self.closed = False

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            self.socket.close()
            self.on_frame("close", 0, "")

    def _fail(self, message):
        self.close()
        raise ModbusResponseError(message)

    def _chunk(self):
        try:
            return self.socket.recv(4096)
        except socket.timeout as error:
            self.close()
            raise ModbusTimeout("응답 제한 시간 초과") from error
        except OSError as error:
            self.close()
            raise ModbusResponseError("수신 실패: " + str(error)) from error

    def _receive(self):
        frames = []
        while not frames:
            chunk = self._chunk()
            if not chunk:
                self._fail("연결 끊김")
            frames = self.buffer.feed(chunk)
            if self.buffer.damaged:
                self._fail("응답 MBAP 손상")
        if len(frames) > 1 or self.buffer.data:
            self._fail("요청보다 응답이 많음")
        return frames[0]

    def request(self, pdu):
        """요청 하나를 보내고 머리를 확인한 응답 PDU를 돌려준다. 예외 응답은 ModbusException이다."""
        if self.closed:
            raise ModbusResponseError("연결이 닫혔음")
        self.transaction = self.transaction % 65535 + 1
        frame = struct.pack(">HHHB", self.transaction, 0, len(pdu) + 1, UNIT_ID) + pdu
        self.on_frame("request", pdu[0], frame.hex(" "))
        try:
            self.socket.sendall(frame)
        except OSError as error:
            self.close()
            raise ModbusResponseError("송신 실패: " + str(error)) from error
        reply = self._receive()
        self.on_frame("response", reply[7] if len(reply) > 7 else 0, reply.hex(" "))
        transaction, _, _, unit = struct.unpack(">HHHB", reply[:7])
        body = reply[7:]
        if transaction != self.transaction:
            self._fail("트랜잭션 ID 불일치")
        if unit != UNIT_ID:
            self._fail("Unit ID 불일치")
        if not body:
            self._fail("빈 응답")
        if body[0] == pdu[0] | 0x80:
            if len(body) != 2:
                self._fail("예외 응답 길이 오류")
            raise ModbusException(pdu[0], body[1])
        if body[0] != pdu[0]:
            self._fail("기능 코드 불일치")
        return body

    def read_bits(self, function, start, count):
        body = self.request(_function_with(function, start, count))
        size = (count + 7) // 8
        if len(body) != 2 + size or body[1] != size:
            self._fail("바이트 수 불일치")
        return _unpack_bits(body[2:], count)

    def read_registers(self, function, start, count):
        body = self.request(_function_with(function, start, count))
        if len(body) != 2 + count * 2 or body[1] != count * 2:
            self._fail("바이트 수 불일치")
        return list(struct.unpack(">" + "H" * count, body[2:]))

    def _write_echo(self, pdu):
        if self.request(pdu) != pdu:
            self._fail("에코 불일치")

    def write_coil(self, address, value):
        self._write_echo(_function_with(WRITE_COIL, address, COIL_ON if value else COIL_OFF))

    def write_register(self, address, value):
        self._write_echo(_function_with(WRITE_REGISTER, address, value))

    def write_registers(self, start, values):
        head = _function_with(WRITE_REGISTERS, start, len(values))
        if self.request(head + bytes((len(values) * 2,)) + _words(*values)) != head:
            self._fail("시작 주소·수량 불일치")


def _function_with(function, first, second):
    return bytes((function,)) + _words(first, second)

class PfmeaError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, errors):
        self.errors = tuple(errors)
        super().__init__("\n".join(self.errors))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reference:
    text: str
    kind: str
    target: str
    report: tuple = ()


def _report_reference(text, value, root):
    parts = value.split(":")
    if len(parts) != 3 or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", parts[0]) is None:
        raise ValueError("report 참조는 파일:방식:열 형식이어야 함: " + text)
    name, method, column = parts
    path = Path(root) / "reports" / (name + ".csv")
    if column not in REPORT_VALUE_COLUMNS:
        raise ValueError("허용하지 않은 보고서 열: " + text)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("없는 보고서: " + text)
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
        reader = csv.DictReader(source)
        rows = list(reader)
    if column not in (reader.fieldnames or ()):
        raise ValueError("보고서에 없는 열: " + text)
    matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("section") == "method" and row.get("method") == method]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError("보고서의 방식 행이 정확히 하나가 아님: " + text)
    number = matches[0][column]
    if number is None:
        raise ValueError("보고서 행에 해당 칸이 없음: " + text)
    if number and re.fullmatch(r"-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?", number) is None:
        raise ValueError("보고서 값이 소수 형식이 아님: " + text)
    provenance = {row.get("method"): row.get("value", "") for row in rows if row.get("section") == "provenance"}
    if any(not provenance.get(key) for key in REQUIRED_PROVENANCE):
        raise ValueError("보고서에 출처가 없음: " + text)
    selection = next((row.get("value", "") for row in rows if row.get("section") == "selection"), "")
    return number, provenance, selection


def _check_test(text, value, root):
    parts = value.split("::")
    if len(parts) != 3 or re.fullmatch(r"tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py", parts[0]) is None:
        raise ValueError("test 참조는 tests/파일.py::클래스::메서드 형식이어야 함: " + text)
    path = Path(root) / parts[0]
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("없는 테스트 파일: " + text)
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except SyntaxError as error:
        raise ValueError("테스트 파일 구문 오류: " + text) from error
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == parts[1]:
            if any(isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == parts[2] for item in node.body):
                return
    raise ValueError("없는 테스트 메서드: " + text)


def resolve_reference(text, root=ROOT):
    """참조 하나를 확인한다. 값은 report만 여기서 읽고 metric은 실행 뒤에 채운다."""
    if text != text.strip() or not text:
        raise ValueError("참조에 빈 조각이나 앞뒤 공백이 있음: " + repr(text))
    kind, separator, value = text.partition(":")
    if not separator or kind not in ("rule", "reason", "test", "metric", "report"):
        raise ValueError("알 수 없는 근거 종류: " + text)
    if kind == "rule":
        if value not in RULE_IDS + ("RULE_RETEST", "RULE_EQUIP"):
            raise ValueError("없는 규칙: " + text)
    elif kind == "reason":
        if value not in REASON_CODES:
            raise ValueError("없는 사유 코드: " + text)
    elif kind == "test":
        _check_test(text, value, root)
    elif kind == "metric":
        if value not in METRICS:
            raise ValueError("없는 지표: " + text)
        return Reference(text, kind, METRICS[value].target)
    else:
        return Reference(text, kind, "product", _report_reference(text, value, root))
    return Reference(text, kind, "record")


def _references(cell, location, errors, root):
    if not cell:
        return []
    found = []
    pieces = cell.split(";")
    if len(set(pieces)) != len(pieces):
        errors.append(location + ": 같은 칸에 중복 참조")
    for piece in pieces:
        try:
            found.append(resolve_reference(piece, root))
        except ValueError as error:
            errors.append(location + ": " + str(error))
    return found


def _check_group(row, index, group, mode, errors):
    columns = ACTION_GROUPS[group]
    filled = [bool(row[column].strip()) for column in columns]
    for column, present in zip(columns, filled):
        location = str(index) + "." + column
        if mode == "blank" and row[column]:
            errors.append(location + ": 이 조치 상태에서는 빈칸이어야 함")
        if mode == "required" and not present:
            errors.append(location + ": 이 조치 상태에서는 필수")
    if mode == "together" and any(filled) and not all(filled):
        errors.append(str(index) + "." + columns[0] + ": " + ", ".join(columns) + "은 함께 있어야 함")


def check_table(rows, models, root=ROOT):
    """표 전체를 검사해 행별 현재 관리·기준 참조를 돌려준다. 문제는 모아서 한 번에 보고한다."""
    steps = {"ALL"} | {step for model in models.values() for step in model.steps}
    steps |= {item.id for model in models.values() for item in model.inspections}
    errors, seen, references = [], [], {}
    for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
        if any(row.get(column) is None for column in INPUT_COLUMNS) or None in row:
            errors.append(str(index) + ": 열 수가 맞지 않음")
            continue
        at = lambda column: str(index) + "." + column
        identifier = row["id"]
        if re.fullmatch(r"PF-[0-9]{2}", identifier) is None:
            errors.append(at("id") + ": 형식은 PF-00이어야 함")
        if identifier in seen:
            errors.append(at("id") + ": 중복 " + identifier)
        elif seen and identifier < seen[-1]:
            errors.append(at("id") + ": id 오름차순이어야 함")
        seen.append(identifier)
        if row["failure_type"] not in FAILURE_TYPES:
            errors.append(at("failure_type") + ": " + ", ".join(FAILURE_TYPES) + " 중 하나여야 함")
        if row["process_step"] not in steps:
            errors.append(at("process_step") + ": 레시피에 없는 공정 또는 검사")
        for column in TEXT_COLUMNS:
            if not row[column].strip():
                errors.append(at(column) + ": 비어 있을 수 없음")
        for columns in (SCORE_COLUMNS, POST_COLUMNS):
            for column in columns:
                if row[column] and re.fullmatch(SCORE_PATTERN, row[column]) is None:
                    errors.append(at(column) + ": 1–10 정수여야 함")
            if any(row[column] for column in columns) and not all(row[column] for column in columns):
                errors.append(at(columns[0]) + ": 점수 3개는 함께 있어야 함")
        if row["post_severity"] and not row["severity"]:
            errors.append(at("post_severity") + ": 조치 전 점수가 필요함")
        if row["evidence"] and not row["evidence_note"].strip():
            errors.append(at("evidence_note") + ": 근거가 있으면 필수")
        state = row["action_state"]
        if state not in ACTION_RULES:
            errors.append(at("action_state") + ": 계획, 완료, 효과 확인 또는 빈칸이어야 함")
            continue
        for group, mode in ACTION_RULES[state].items():
            _check_group(row, index, group, mode, errors)
        current = _references(row["evidence"], at("evidence"), errors, root)
        _references(row["action_evidence"], at("action_evidence"), errors, root)
        success = None
        if row["success_reference"]:
            found = _references(row["success_reference"], at("success_reference"), errors, root)
            if found and (len(found) != 1 or found[0].kind not in ("metric", "report")):
                errors.append(at("success_reference") + ": metric 또는 report 참조 1개여야 함")
            elif found:
                success = found[0]
        if row["success_op"] and row["success_op"] not in (">=", "<="):
            errors.append(at("success_op") + ": >= 또는 <=여야 함")
        if row["success_value"] and re.fullmatch(r"-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?", row["success_value"]) is None:
            errors.append(at("success_value") + ": 소수 형식이어야 함")
        references[identifier] = current, success
    if errors:
        raise PfmeaError(errors)
    return references


def read_table(path):
    with Path(path).open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
        reader = csv.DictReader(source, strict=True)
        if reader.fieldnames != list(INPUT_COLUMNS):
            raise PfmeaError(["0: 헤더는 " + ",".join(INPUT_COLUMNS) + " 이어야 함"])
        return list(reader)


def run_counts(analysis, defective, faulty):
    """한 실행의 원시 분자·분모다. 합산은 merge_counts가 한다."""
    products = analysis.process.products
    defective = set(defective)
    first, every = analysis.first_inspections, analysis.all_inspections
    bad = [product_id for product_id in products if product_id in defective]
    normal = [product_id for product_id in products if product_id not in defective]
    defect_first = [record for record in first if record.product_id in defective]
    leak_first = [record for record in defect_first if record.inspection == "LEAK"]
    retested = {record.product_id for record in every if record.product_id in defective
                and record.inspection == "LEAK" and record.retest_number > 0}
    counts = {
        "defect_escape": (sum(products[item].status == COMPLETED for item in bad), len(bad)),
        "all_defect_first_fail": (sum(record.result == "FAIL" for record in defect_first), len(defect_first)),
        "leak_defect_first_fail": (sum(record.result == "FAIL" for record in leak_first), len(leak_first)),
        "leak_defect_retest_pass": (sum(products[item].inspections.get("LEAK") == "PASS" for item in retested),
                                    len(retested)),
        "normal_reject": (sum(products[item].status in ("보류", "폐기") for item in normal), len(normal)),
    }
    stopped_pairs, delay = 0, 0
    detail = {}
    for name in faulty:
        stops = [stop for stop in analysis.stop_history if stop.equipment == name]
        stopped_pairs += bool(stops)
        detail[name] = (int(bool(stops)), 1)
        if stops:
            delay += sum(record.equipment == name and record.row_index <= stops[0].row_index for record in first)
    pairs = len(faulty)
    healthy_stops = sum(stop.equipment not in faulty for stop in analysis.stop_history)
    healthy_first = sum(record.equipment not in faulty for record in first)
    counts.update(
        fault_stop_run=(stopped_pairs, pairs), fault_no_stop_run=(pairs - stopped_pairs, pairs),
        fault_stop_delay=(delay, stopped_pairs), normal_stop_rate=(healthy_stops, healthy_first),
    )
    return counts, detail


def merge_counts(runs):
    """실행별 원시 값을 더한다. 실행별 비율을 평균하지 않는다."""
    total = {name: (0, 0) for name in METRICS}
    detail = {}
    for counts, equipment in runs:
        for name, (numerator, denominator) in counts.items():
            total[name] = (total[name][0] + numerator, total[name][1] + denominator)
        for name, (numerator, denominator) in equipment.items():
            old = detail.get(name, (0, 0))
            detail[name] = (old[0] + numerator, old[1] + denominator)
    return total, detail


def collect(config, recipe, book, seeds, products):
    runs = []
    for seed in seeds:
        generator = Generator(seed, config, recipe.models, book)
        normal = generator.normal_events(products)
        analysis = build_analysis(normal, recipe.models, book)
        runs.append(run_counts(analysis, generator.defective_products, sorted(config["fault_shift_sigma"])))
    return merge_counts(runs)


def show_ratio(numerator, denominator):
    if not denominator:
        return ""
    value = Decimal(numerator) / Decimal(denominator)
    return format(value.quantize(Decimal("0.0001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), ".4f")


def reference_value(reference, metrics):
    """비교에 쓸 정확한 값이다. 표시용으로 반올림하지 않는다. 없으면 None이다."""
    if reference.kind == "report":
        return Fraction(reference.report[0]) if reference.report[0] else None
    if reference.kind != "metric":
        return None
    numerator, denominator = metrics[reference.text.partition(":")[2]]
    return Fraction(numerator, denominator) if denominator else None


def effect_result(value, operator, limit):
    if value is None:
        return "값 없음"
    limit = Fraction(limit)
    return "충족" if (value >= limit if operator == ">=" else value <= limit) else "미충족"


def evidence_status(failure_type, references, metrics):
    if not references:
        return "근거 없음"
    matching = [reference for reference in references if reference.target == failure_type]
    if not matching:
        return "근거 부족"
    if all(reference.kind in ("metric", "report") and reference_value(reference, metrics) is None
           for reference in matching):
        return "값 없음"
    return "연결됨"


def rpn(row, columns):
    return int(row[columns[0]]) * int(row[columns[1]]) * int(row[columns[2]]) if row[columns[0]] else None


def scored_fields(row):
    before, after = rpn(row, SCORE_COLUMNS), rpn(row, POST_COLUMNS)
    return dict(
        score_status="점수 대기" if before is None else "점수 입력",
        rpn="" if before is None else before,
        post_rpn="" if after is None else after,
        priority="우선" if row["severity"] and int(row["severity"]) >= 9 else "",
        rpn_change="" if after is None else after - before,
    )


def _row(section, **fields):
    return {column: fields.get(column, section if column == "section" else "") for column in REPORT_COLUMNS}


def _reference_fields(reference, metrics, source):
    if reference.kind == "metric":
        name = reference.text.partition(":")[2]
        numerator, denominator = metrics[name]
        return dict(reference=reference.text, target=reference.target, scope=METRICS[name].scope, numerator=numerator,
                    denominator=denominator, value=show_ratio(numerator, denominator), assumption=METRIC_ASSUMPTION,
                    text=OVERALL if METRICS[name].overall else "", **source)
    if reference.kind == "report":
        number, provenance, selection = reference.report
        return dict(reference=reference.text, target=reference.target, value=number, assumption=REPORT_ASSUMPTION,
                    generator_version=provenance["generator_version"], config_sha256=provenance["config_sha256"],
                    recipe_sha256=provenance.get("recipe_sha256", ""),
                    equipment_sha256=provenance.get("equipment_sha256", ""), seeds=provenance["seeds"],
                    products=provenance["products"], text=selection)
    return dict(reference=reference.text, target=reference.target)


def build_report(rows, references, metrics, detail, alternatives, source):
    report = [_row("notice", text=text) for text in
              (PRACTICE_NOTICE, ASSUMPTION_NOTICE, METRIC_NOTICE, LINK_NOTICE)]
    statuses = {}
    for row in rows:
        current, success = references[row["id"]]
        status = evidence_status(row["failure_type"], current, metrics)
        statuses[row["id"]] = status
        result = ""
        if row["action_state"] == "효과 확인":
            result = effect_result(reference_value(success, metrics), row["success_op"], row["success_value"])
        report.append(_row("item", evidence_status=status, effect_result=result, **scored_fields(row),
                           **{column: row[column] for column in INPUT_COLUMNS}))
    for row in rows:
        for reference in references[row["id"]][0]:
            report.append(_row("evidence", id=row["id"], **_reference_fields(reference, metrics, source)))
    for row in rows:
        if row["action_state"] == "효과 확인":
            success = references[row["id"]][1]
            fields = _reference_fields(success, metrics, source)
            fields["text"] = " ".join(filter(None, (row["success_op"] + " " + row["success_value"], fields["text"])))
            report.append(_row("action", id=row["id"], effect_result=effect_result(
                reference_value(success, metrics), row["success_op"], row["success_value"]), **fields))
    for name in METRICS:
        report.append(_row("metric", **_reference_fields(Reference("metric:" + name, "metric", METRICS[name].target),
                                                         metrics, source)))
    for name, (numerator, denominator) in sorted(detail.items()):
        report.append(_row("fault_detail", reference=name, target="equipment", numerator=numerator,
                           denominator=denominator, value=show_ratio(numerator, denominator), **source))
    for condition, counts in alternatives:
        for name in ALTERNATIVE_METRICS:
            numerator, denominator = counts[name]
            report.append(_row("alternative", condition=condition, reference=name, target=METRICS[name].target,
                               scope=METRICS[name].scope, numerator=numerator, denominator=denominator,
                               value=show_ratio(numerator, denominator), assumption=METRIC_ASSUMPTION, **source))
    for failure_type in FAILURE_TYPES:
        for status in ("연결됨", "값 없음", "근거 부족", "근거 없음"):
            count = sum(row["failure_type"] == failure_type and statuses[row["id"]] == status for row in rows)
            report.append(_row("coverage", failure_type=failure_type, evidence_status=status, value=count))
    return report


def _cell(value):
    return str(value).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ") if value != "" else "-"


def _table(lines, heading, columns, rows):
    lines.extend(("", "## " + heading, "", "| " + " | ".join(columns) + " |", "|" + " --- |" * len(columns)))
    lines.extend("| " + " | ".join(_cell(value) for value in row) + " |" for row in rows)


def build_markdown(report):
    lines = ["# 합성 공정 PFMEA 연습", "", PRACTICE_NOTICE, "", ASSUMPTION_NOTICE, "", METRIC_NOTICE, "", LINK_NOTICE]
    items = [row for row in report if row["section"] == "item"]
    observed = {row["id"]: row["value"] for row in report if row["section"] == "action"}
    for item in items:
        lines.extend(("", "## " + item["id"] + " " + item["failure_mode"], ""))
        for label, column in (("유형", "failure_type"), ("대상", "process_step"), ("기능", "function_requirement"),
                              ("영향(가정)", "effect"), ("원인(가정)", "cause"), ("예방 관리", "prevention_control"),
                              ("검출 관리", "detection_control"), ("점수", "score_status"), ("근거 상태", "evidence_status"),
                              ("근거 참조", "evidence"), ("근거 설명", "evidence_note"), ("조치", "action"),
                              ("조치 상태", "action_state"), ("조치 목적", "action_goal"),
                              ("조치 전 관리", "control_before"), ("조치 후 관리", "control_after"),
                              ("조치 근거", "action_evidence"), ("잔여 위험", "residual_risk")):
            lines.append("- " + label + ": " + _cell(item[column]))
        if item["success_reference"]:
            lines.append("- 사전 기준: " + " ".join(item[column] for column in SUCCESS_COLUMNS))
        if item["effect_result"]:
            lines.append("- 관측값: " + _cell(observed.get(item["id"], "")))
            lines.append("- 효과 판정: " + item["effect_result"])
    _table(lines, "지표", ("지표", "범위", "분자", "분모", "값"),
           [(row["reference"], row["scope"], row["numerator"], row["denominator"], row["value"])
            for row in report if row["section"] == "metric"])
    _table(lines, "재검사 대안 비교 (합산 비교, 제품 짝 비교 아님)", ("조건", "지표", "분자", "분모", "값"),
           [(row["condition"], row["reference"], row["numerator"], row["denominator"], row["value"])
            for row in report if row["section"] == "alternative"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def write_outputs(stem, report):
    directory = Path("reports")
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = directory / (stem + "_report.csv")
    with csv_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=REPORT_COLUMNS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(report)
    markdown_path = directory / (stem + "_report.md")
    with markdown_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        target.write(build_markdown(report))
    return csv_path, markdown_path


def run(table_path, config_path, seed_text, products, root=ROOT):
    if products < 1:
        raise ValueError("products는 양의 정수여야 함")
    seeds = parse_seeds(seed_text)
    config, content, recipe, book = load_setup(config_path)
    if "process_cpk" not in config:
        raise ValueError("--config는 측정 설정이어야 함")
    rows = read_table(table_path)
    references = check_table(rows, recipe.models, root)
    source = dict(generator_version=generator_version(config), config_sha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),
                  recipe_sha256=recipe.sha256, equipment_sha256=book.sha256, seeds=seed_text, products=products)
    alternatives = []
    metrics, detail = None, None
    for condition, probability in ALTERNATIVES:
        changed = config if probability is None else dict(config, retest_probability=probability)
        counts, equipment = collect(changed, recipe, book, seeds, products)
        if probability is None:
            metrics, detail = counts, equipment
        alternatives.append((condition, counts))
    return build_report(rows, references, metrics, detail, alternatives, source)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("table", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    parser.add_argument("--seeds", required=True, help="시작-끝, 예: 0-29")
    parser.add_argument("--products", type=int, default=500)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        report = run(args.table, args.config, args.seeds, args.products)
        csv_path, markdown_path = write_outputs(args.table.stem, report)
    except PfmeaError as error:
        parser.exit(3, "PFMEA 표 오류:\n" + "\n".join(error.errors) + "\n")
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, csv.Error, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
        parser.exit(2, "오류: " + str(error) + "\n")
    print(PRACTICE_NOTICE)
    print("id | 유형 | 점수 | 근거 | 효과 판정")
    for row in report:
        if row["section"] == "item":
            print(" | ".join((row["id"], row["failure_type"], row["score_status"], row["evidence_status"],
                              row["effect_result"])))
    print("저장 파일: " + csv_path.as_posix() + ", " + markdown_path.as_posix())
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
