def takt_of(line):
    return Fraction(line.net, line.demand)


def target_uph(line):
    return Fraction(line.demand * 3_600_000, line.net)


def fits(load, net, demand):
    return load * demand <= net


def manual_bound(elements, net, demand):
    models = {model for element in elements for model in element.times}
    totals = (sum(element.times.get(model, 0) for element in elements if not element.inspection) for model in models)
    return max(ceil(Fraction(total * demand, net)) for total in totals)


def _ordered(elements):
    """입력 순서를 유지한 위상 순서다."""
    placed, ordered, remaining = set(), [], list(elements)
    while remaining:
        for element in remaining:
            if set(element.predecessors) <= placed:
                ordered.append(element)
                placed.add(element.id)
                remaining.remove(element)
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError("선행 순환")
    return ordered


def _idle_cost(members, ratios, net, demand):
    takt = Fraction(net, demand)
    return sum(ratio * (takt - sum(element.times.get(model, 0) for element in members)) ** 2
               for model, ratio in ratios.items())


def optimal_balance(elements, ratios, net, demand):
    """(수작업 작업장 수, 유휴 제곱합, 배치 키)의 사전순 최소를 부분집합 동적 계획으로 찾는다."""
    ordered = _ordered(elements)
    index = {element.id: position for position, element in enumerate(ordered)}
    rank = {element.id: position for position, element in enumerate(elements)}
    needs = [sum(1 << index[parent] for parent in element.predecessors) for element in ordered]
    full = (1 << len(ordered)) - 1
    memo = {}

    def station_key(members):
        return tuple(sorted((element.id for element in members), key=rank.get))

    def choices(mask):
        for position, element in enumerate(ordered):
            if element.inspection and not mask >> position & 1 and needs[position] & ~mask == 0:
                yield (element,), 1 << position

        def extend(start, chosen, used):
            for position in range(start, len(ordered)):
                element = ordered[position]
                if element.inspection or (mask | used) >> position & 1 or needs[position] & ~(mask | used):
                    continue
                members = chosen + (element,)
                if all(fits(sum(item.times.get(model, 0) for item in members), net, demand) for model in ratios):
                    yield members, used | 1 << position
                    yield from extend(position + 1, members, used | 1 << position)

        yield from extend(0, (), 0)

    def best(mask):
        if mask == full:
            return (0, Fraction(0), ())
        if mask in memo:
            return memo[mask]
        result = None
        for members, used in choices(mask):
            rest = best(mask | used)
            if rest is None:
                continue
            manual = not members[0].inspection
            cost = _idle_cost(members, ratios, net, demand) if manual else Fraction(0)
            candidate = (rest[0] + manual, rest[1] + cost, (station_key(members),) + rest[2])
            if result is None or candidate < result:
                result = candidate
        memo[mask] = result
        return result

    found = best(0)
    return None if found is None else Balance(found[2], found[0], found[1])


def heuristic_balance(elements, ratios, net, demand):
    """RPW 휴리스틱이다. 제약은 전수 탐색과 같다."""
    by_id = {element.id: element for element in elements}
    children = {element.id: set() for element in elements}
    for element in elements:
        for parent in element.predecessors:
            children[parent].add(element.id)

    def family(name):
        found = {name}
        for child in children[name]:
            found |= family(child)
        return found

    weights = {element.id: sum(ratio * by_id[name].times.get(model, 0) for name in family(element.id)
                               for model, ratio in ratios.items()) for element in elements}
    rank = {element.id: position for position, element in enumerate(elements)}
    done, stations = set(), []
    while len(done) < len(elements):
        current = []
        while True:
            placed = done | {element.id for element in current}
            candidates = [element for element in elements if element.id not in placed and not element.inspection
                          and set(element.predecessors) <= placed
                          and all(fits(sum(item.times.get(model, 0) for item in current + [element]), net, demand)
                                  for model in ratios)]
            if not candidates:
                break
            current.append(max(candidates, key=lambda element: (weights[element.id], -rank[element.id])))
        if current:
            stations.append(current)
            done |= {element.id for element in current}
            continue
        ready = [element for element in elements if element.id not in done and element.inspection
                 and set(element.predecessors) <= done]
        if not ready:
            return None
        chosen = max(ready, key=lambda element: (weights[element.id], -rank[element.id]))
        stations.append([chosen])
        done.add(chosen.id)
    manual = [members for members in stations if not members[0].inspection]
    cost = sum((_idle_cost(members, ratios, net, demand) for members in manual), Fraction(0))
    return Balance(tuple(tuple(sorted((element.id for element in members), key=rank.get)) for members in stations),
                   len(manual), cost)


def simulate(stations, routes, buffer_units, repair):
    """사건 기반 시뮬레이션이다. 같은 시각의 이동은 변화가 없을 때까지 반복한다."""
    buffers = [deque() for _ in stations]
    # 서버 상태: [상태, 경로, 시작 시각]. 상태는 idle, busy, done, down이다.
    servers = [[["idle", None, 0] for _ in range(station.servers)] for station in stations]
    waiting = deque(routes)
    events, result, repairs, remaining = [], SimResult(), [], len(routes)
    clock = 0
    order = 0

    def service(route, index):
        station = stations[index]
        time = station.times.get(route.model, 0)
        if station.inspection is None:
            return time
        return route.attempts.get(station.inspection, 0) * time

    def target_after(route, index):
        if index >= 0 and stations[index].inspection and stations[index].inspection == route.end_inspection:
            return None
        for position in range(index + 1, len(stations)):
            if service(route, position) > 0:
                return position
        return None

    def begin(route, index):
        nonlocal order
        for number, server in enumerate(servers[index]):
            if server[0] == "idle":
                duration = service(route, index)
                server[:] = ["busy", route, clock]
                order += 1
                heapq.heappush(events, (clock + duration, order, index, number))
                result.work[stations[index].id] += duration
                return True
        return False

    def free(index):
        return any(server[0] == "idle" for server in servers[index])

    def leave(route):
        nonlocal remaining
        remaining -= 1
        result.left += 1
        result.passed += route.completed
        result.good += route.good
        result.escaped += route.completed and route.defective
        result.end = clock

    def release(index, number, route):
        nonlocal order
        server = servers[index][number]
        result.blocked[stations[index].id] += clock - server[2]
        if stations[index].inspection in route.stops and repair > 0:
            server[:] = ["down", None, clock]
            order += 1
            heapq.heappush(events, (clock + repair, order, index, number))
            repairs.append((stations[index].id, clock))
        else:
            server[:] = ["idle", None, 0]

    def settle():
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for index in range(len(stations) - 1, -1, -1):
                for number, server in enumerate(servers[index]):
                    if server[0] != "done":
                        continue
                    route = server[1]
                    target = target_after(route, index)
                    if target is None:
                        leave(route)
                    elif not buffers[target] and free(target):
                        begin(route, target)
                    elif len(buffers[target]) < buffer_units:
                        buffers[target].append((route, clock))
                    else:
                        continue
                    release(index, number, route)
                    changed = True
            for index in range(len(stations) - 1, -1, -1):
                while buffers[index] and free(index):
                    route, arrived = buffers[index].popleft()
                    result.wait += clock - arrived
                    begin(route, index)
                    changed = True
            while waiting:
                route = waiting[0]
                target = target_after(route, -1)
                if target is None:
                    waiting.popleft()
                    leave(route)
                elif free(target):
                    waiting.popleft()
                    begin(route, target)
                else:
                    break
                changed = True

    settle()
    while remaining:
        if not events:
            raise ValueError("교착: 남은 제품이 있는데 다음 사건이 없음")
        clock = events[0][0]
        while events and events[0][0] == clock:
            _, _, index, number = heapq.heappop(events)
            server = servers[index][number]
            if server[0] == "busy":
                server[0], server[2] = "done", clock
            else:
                server[:] = ["idle", None, 0]
        settle()
    for name, start in repairs:
        result.repair[name] += max(0, min(start + repair, result.end) - start)
    return result


def _fixed(value):
    return format(value.quantize(Decimal("0.0001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), ".4f")


def show(value):
    """분수를 표시 문자열로 바꾼다. 비교에는 쓰지 않는다."""
    fraction = Fraction(value)
    return _fixed(Decimal(fraction.numerator) / Decimal(fraction.denominator))


def uph(count, end):
    return Fraction(count * 3_600_000, end) if end else Fraction(0)


def cycle_limits(takt, count, visits, good_rate):
    """명목 상한과 양품 보정 상한이다. 방문이 없으면 None이다."""
    if not visits:
        return None
    return takt * count / visits, takt * count * good_rate / visits


def select_combo(candidates):
    """(면적, 총 대수, 조합, 통과) 중 통과한 것의 최솟값을 고른다."""
    passed = [item[:3] for item in candidates if item[3]]
    return min(passed)[2] if passed else None


def holdout_result(selected, value, target):
    if selected is None:
        return NO_SELECTION
    return "확인" if value >= target else "미달"


def build_stations(line, balance, combo):
    by_id = {element.id: element for element in line.elements}
    stations = []
    for number, members in enumerate(balance.stations, 1):
        items = [by_id[name] for name in members]
        models = {model for element in items for model in element.times}
        times = {model: sum(element.times.get(model, 0) for element in items) for model in models}
        inspection = items[0].step if items[0].inspection else None
        stations.append(SimStation("S" + str(number), combo[inspection] if inspection else 1, times, inspection))
    return stations


def area_of(line, combo):
    return sum(count * line.machines[name].width * (line.machines[name].depth + line.machines[name].service)
               for name, count in combo.items())


def layout_of(line, balance, combo):
    """제약 계산과 SVG가 같은 좌표를 쓴다."""
    by_id = {element.id: element for element in line.elements}
    boxes, x = [], 0
    pitch = line.buffer_units * line.floor.pitch

class StationError(ValueError):
    """설정 문제를 위치와 함께 모아서 보고한다. 종료 코드는 3이다."""

    def __init__(self, errors):
        super().__init__("\n".join(errors))
        self.errors = errors

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Station:
    generator: Path
    inspection: str
    timing: Timing
    plc_stale_cycles: int
    delays: dict
    post_alarm_cycles: int
    max_cycles: int


def _check_keys(data, allowed, location, errors):
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        errors.append(location + ": 객체여야 함")
        return False
    errors.extend(location + "." + key + ": 없는 키" for key in allowed if key not in data)
    errors.extend(location + "." + key + ": 허용 밖 키" for key in data if key not in allowed)
    return True


def _check_integer(value, location, errors):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
        errors.append(location + ": 1 이상의 정수여야 함")


def load_station(path):
    """설정을 읽어 검증한다. 문제는 위치와 함께 모아서 보고한다."""
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except ValueError as error:
        raise StationError(["$: JSON 오류: " + str(error)]) from error
    errors = []
    _check_keys(data, TOP_KEYS, "$", errors)
    if errors:
        raise StationError(errors)
    for key in ("generator", "inspection"):
        if not isinstance(data[key], str) or not data[key].strip():
            errors.append("$." + key + ": 비어 있지 않은 문자열이어야 함")
    for key in INTEGER_KEYS:
        _check_integer(data[key], "$." + key, errors)
    for name, keys in (("timeouts", TIMEOUT_KEYS), ("delays", DELAY_KEYS)):
        location = "$." + name
        if _check_keys(data[name], keys, location, errors):
            for key in keys:
                if key in data[name]:
                    _check_integer(data[name][key], location + "." + key, errors)
    if errors:
        raise StationError(errors)
    return Station(path.parent / data["generator"], data["inspection"],
                   Timing(data["heartbeat_scans"], dict(data["timeouts"])), data["plc_stale_cycles"],
                   dict(data["delays"]), data["post_alarm_cycles"], data["max_cycles"])


def load_values(station, seed, products):
    """측정 설정의 정상 사건에서 LEAK 최초 측정 value를 제품 순서대로 가져온다."""
    config, _, recipe, book = load_setup(station.generator)
    if "process_cpk" not in config or not is_measured(recipe.models):
        raise ValueError("generator는 측정 설정이어야 함")
    items = {(item.lsl, item.usl): item for model in recipe.models.values() for item in model.inspections
             if item.id == station.inspection}
    if len(items) != 1 or None in next(iter(items)):
        raise ValueError(station.inspection + ": 모든 모델에서 같은 양측 규격이어야 함")
    first = {}
    for row in Generator(seed, config, recipe.models, book).normal_events(products):
        if row["inspection"] == station.inspection and row["value"]:
            first.setdefault(row["product_id"], row["value"])
    if len(first) != products:
        raise ValueError(station.inspection + ": 측정값이 없는 제품이 있음")
    # 문자열로 정렬하면 GEN_10000이 GEN_1001 앞에 온다.
    ordered = sorted(first, key=lambda product: int(product.rpartition("_")[2]))
    return [first[product] for product in ordered], next(iter(items.values()))


class Plant:
    """모의 설비다. 직전 스캔의 출력과 자기 상태만 보고 입력 비트를 갱신한다."""

    def __init__(self, table, delays, values):
        self.table = table
        self.delays = delays
        self.values = values
        self.product = 0
        self.inputs = {name: False for name in INPUTS}
        self.inputs["clamp_open"] = self.inputs["guard_closed"] = True
        self.raw = ""
        self.timers = {}
        self.forced = {}
        self._publish()

    def _due(self, name, trigger, cycle):
        """트리거를 처음 본 주기를 기억하고, 지연이 지나면 참을 돌려준다. 트리거가 꺼지면 취소한다."""
        if not trigger:
            self.timers.pop(name, None)
            return False
        due = self.timers.setdefault(name, cycle + self.delays[name])
        if cycle >= due:
            del self.timers[name]
            return True
        return False

    def _publish(self):
        merged = {**self.inputs, **self.forced}
        with self.table.lock:
            self.table.discrete[:len(INPUTS)] = [merged[name] for name in INPUTS]

    def update(self, cycle, outputs):
        """트리거는 갱신 전 값으로 본다. 주입은 정상 갱신 뒤에 덮어쓴다."""
        now = dict(self.inputs)
        changes = {}
        if self._due("arrive", not now["part_present"] and self.product < len(self.values), cycle):
            changes["part_present"] = True
        if self._due("seat", now["part_present"] and not now["seated"], cycle):
            changes["seated"] = changes["direction_ok"] = True
        if outputs["clamp_cmd"]:
            changes["clamp_open"] = False
        elif not now["clamp_open"]:
            changes["clamp_closed"] = False
        if self._due("clamp_close", outputs["clamp_cmd"] and not now["clamp_closed"], cycle):
            changes["clamp_closed"] = True
        if self._due("clamp_open", not outputs["clamp_cmd"] and not now["clamp_open"], cycle):
            changes["clamp_open"] = True
        if not outputs["measure_cmd"]:
            changes["measure_done"] = False
            self.raw = ""
        if self._due("measure", outputs["measure_cmd"] and not now["measure_done"], cycle):
            changes["measure_done"] = True
            self.raw = self.values[self.product]
        if self._due("discharge", (outputs["gate_ok"] or outputs["gate_ng"]) and now["part_present"], cycle):
            changes["part_present"] = changes["seated"] = changes["direction_ok"] = False
            self.product += 1
        self.inputs.update(changes)
        self._publish()


class Pc:
    """판정 PC다. 요청마다 응답을 다 받은 뒤 다음으로 넘어간다."""

    def __init__(self, client, item, stale_cycles):
        self.client = client
        self.item = item
        self.stale_cycles = stale_cycles
        self.heartbeat = 0
        self.judged_id = 0
        self.plc_heartbeat = 0
        self.plc_change = 0
        self.stale_noted = False
        self.fault = ""
        self.events = []

    def _exchange(self, cycle):
        if self.fault != "no_heartbeat":
            self.heartbeat = (self.heartbeat + 1) % 65536
            self.client.write_register(HEARTBEAT_REGISTER, self.heartbeat)
        registers = self.client.read_registers(READ_INPUT, 0, 7)
        if registers[REG_HEARTBEAT] != self.plc_heartbeat:
            self.plc_heartbeat = registers[REG_HEARTBEAT]
            self.plc_change = cycle
            self.stale_noted = False
        if cycle - self.plc_change > self.stale_cycles:
            if not self.stale_noted:
                self.stale_noted = True
                self.events.append("PLC 무응답")
            return
        measure_id = registers[REG_MEASURE_ID]
        if registers[REG_STATE] != WAIT_JUDGE or measure_id == self.judged_id or self.fault == "no_judge":
            return
        self.judged_id = measure_id
        value = restore_value(registers[REG_VALUE_HIGH], registers[REG_VALUE_LOW])
        verdict = JUDGE_PASS if judge_value(value, self.item) == "PASS" else JUDGE_FAIL
        self.client.write_registers(JUDGE_REGISTER, [measure_id - 1 if self.fault == "stale" else measure_id, verdict])

    def cycle(self, cycle):
        self.events = []
        if self.fault == "close":
            self.client.close()
        if self.client.closed:
            return
        try:
            self._exchange(cycle)
        except (ModbusResponseError, ModbusException) as error:
            self.events.append("통신 실패: " + str(error))

def prepared(products):
    rows = []
    for product_id in products:
        for name, model in (("REGISTER", "B"), ("P1", ""), ("P2", "")):

class JudgmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_t89_boundaries_are_pass_and_raw_value_is_kept(self):
        values = ["13", "13.000", "7", "13.001", "6.999"]
        products = ["p" + str(index) for index in range(5)]
        rows = prepared(products)
        process = RecipeProcess(MODELS, BOOK)
        apply_all(process, rows)
        decisions = []
        for index, (product_id, value) in enumerate(zip(products, values)):
            # 설비 창이 FAIL로 정지하지 않게 제품마다 다른 설비 조합을 쓴다.
            equipment = "LEAK-3" if value == "6.999" else "LEAK-1"
            decisions.append(process.apply(leak(len(rows) + index + 1, product_id, value, equipment)))
        self.assertEqual([item.result for item in decisions], ["PASS", "PASS", "PASS", "FAIL", "FAIL"])
        self.assertEqual([item.value for item in decisions], values)
        self.assertEqual(decisions[0].input_text, "INSPECT LEAK PASS @LEAK-1 value=13")
        self.assertEqual(decisions[3].input_text, "INSPECT LEAK FAIL @LEAK-1 value=13.001")
        self.assertEqual(process.products["p3"].status, "보류")
        self.assertEqual(process.products["p4"].status, "보류")
        self.assertIn("value=13.001", process.products["p3"].history)

import unittest

from src.modbus import RELEASE_COIL, RESET_COIL, Table
from src.plc import (
    ALARM, CHECK, CLAMP, DISCHARGE, IDLE, INPUTS, MEASURE, OUTPUTS, PUBLISH, REG_COUNT, REG_HEARTBEAT, REG_MEASURE_ID,
    REG_VALUE_HIGH, REG_VALUE_LOW, UNCLAMP, WAIT_JUDGE, Plc, Timing, interlock,

TIMEOUTS = {"check_scans": 30, "clamp_scans": 20, "measure_scans": 50, "judge_scans": 30, "unclamp_scans": 20,
            "discharge_scans": 30}


class Rig:
    """정상 입력에서 시작해 스캔마다 PC 하트비트를 올리는 시험 장치다."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.table = Table()
        self.plc = Plc(self.table, Timing(10, TIMEOUTS))
        self.set(clamp_open=True, guard_closed=True)

    def set(self, **signals):
        for name, value in signals.items():
            self.table.discrete[INPUTS.index(name)] = value

    def scan(self, value="", beat=True):
        if beat:
            self.table.holding[0] = (self.table.holding[0] + 1) % 65536
        return self.plc.scan(value)

    def judge(self, judge_id, verdict):
        self.table.holding[1:3] = [judge_id, verdict]

    def reach(self, state):
        """정상 순서로 목표 상태까지 간다."""
        steps = [
            (CHECK, dict(part_present=True)),
            (CLAMP, dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True)),
            (MEASURE, dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True)),
            (PUBLISH, dict(measure_done=True)),
            (WAIT_JUDGE, dict(measure_done=False)),
            (UNCLAMP, dict()),
            (DISCHARGE, dict(clamp_closed=False, clamp_open=True)),
        ]
        for target, signals in steps:
            self.set(**signals)
            if target == UNCLAMP:
                self.judge(self.plc.measure_id, 1)
            self.scan("10.250" if target == PUBLISH else "")
            if target == state:
                return


def outputs(**fields):
    return {name: fields.get(name, False) for name in OUTPUTS}


def inputs(**fields):
    base = dict(clamp_open=True, guard_closed=True, seated=True, direction_ok=True)
    base.update(fields)
    return {name: base.get(name, False) for name in INPUTS}


class ScanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_t153_snapshot_is_used_for_the_whole_scan(self):
        rig = Rig()
        rig.table.holding[0] = 1

        def change():
            rig.set(part_present=True)

        rig.plc.scan(after_snapshot=change)
        self.assertEqual(rig.plc.state, IDLE)
        self.assertEqual(rig.scan(), CHECK)

    def test_t154_full_sequence_one_transition_per_scan(self):
        rig = Rig()
        steps = [dict(part_present=True), dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True),
                 dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True), dict(measure_done=True), dict(measure_done=False),
                 None, dict(clamp_closed=False, clamp_open=True),
                 dict(part_present=False, seated=False, direction_ok=False)]
        states = []
        for number, signals in enumerate(steps, 1):
            if signals is None:
                rig.judge(1, 1)
            else:
                rig.set(**signals)
            states.append(rig.scan("10.250" if number == 4 else ""))
            if number == 5:
                self.assertEqual(rig.table.input_registers[REG_MEASURE_ID], 1)
                self.assertEqual((rig.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_HIGH], rig.table.input_registers[REG_VALUE_LOW]),
                                 (0x0000, 0x280A))
                self.assertEqual(rig.table.holding[1:3], [0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(states, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0])
        self.assertEqual(rig.table.input_registers[REG_COUNT], 1)
        self.assertEqual(rig.plc.ok_count, 1)

    def test_outputs_follow_each_state(self):
        rig = Rig()
        expected = {CLAMP: "10000", MEASURE: "11000", PUBLISH: "10000", WAIT_JUDGE: "10000", UNCLAMP: "00000",
                    DISCHARGE: "00100"}
        for state, bits in expected.items():
            rig = Rig()
            rig.reach(state)
            self.assertEqual("".join("1" if rig.plc.outputs[name] else "0" for name in OUTPUTS), bits, state)

    def test_ng_verdict_opens_ng_gate_only(self):
        rig = Rig()
        rig.reach(WAIT_JUDGE)
        rig.judge(1, 2)
        rig.scan()
        rig.set(clamp_closed=False, clamp_open=True)
        rig.scan()
        self.assertTrue(rig.plc.outputs["gate_ng"])
        self.assertFalse(rig.plc.outputs["gate_ok"])

@dataclass
class SimResult:
    end: int = 0
    left: int = 0
    passed: int = 0
    good: int = 0
    escaped: int = 0
    wait: int = 0
    work: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    blocked: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    repair: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=Counter)

    def add(self, other):
        self.end += other.end
        self.left += other.left
        self.passed += other.passed
        self.good += other.good
        self.escaped += other.escaped
        self.wait += other.wait
        for name in ("work", "blocked", "repair"):
            getattr(self, name).update(getattr(other, name))

class Rows:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []

    def add(self, product_id, event, inspection="", result="", model="", equipment="", value=""):
        self.rows.append(dict(zip(COLUMNS, (str(len(self.rows) + 1), product_id, event, inspection, result, model,
                                            equipment, value))))
        return self

    def product(self, product_id):
        self.add(product_id, "REGISTER", model="B")
        return self.add(product_id, "P1").add(product_id, "P2")

    def leak(self, product_id, value, equipment):
        return self.add(product_id, "INSPECT", "LEAK", equipment=equipment, value=str(value))

    def light(self, product_id, value):
        return self.add(product_id, "INSPECT", "LIGHT", equipment="LIGHT-1", value=str(value))

    def retest(self, product_id):
        return self.add(product_id, "RETEST_REQUEST", "LEAK")

    def restart(self, equipment, result):
        return self.add("", "EQUIP_RESTART", result=result, equipment=equipment)

    def finish(self, product_id):
        self.add(product_id, "P3").add(product_id, "P4")
        return self.light(product_id, 10)

    def stops(self, equipment, values, prefix):
        for index, value in enumerate(values):
            self.product(prefix + str(index)).leak(prefix + str(index), value, equipment)
        return self

    def counts(self, defective=(), faulty=()):
        analysis = build_analysis(self.rows, MODELS, BOOK)
        self.assert_accepted(analysis)
        return run_counts(analysis, defective, sorted(faulty))

    @staticmethod
    def assert_accepted(analysis):
        rejected = [decision.reason for decision in analysis.decisions if not decision.accepted]
        assert not rejected, rejected


def fixture_f():
    rows = Rows()
    for product_id in "abcd":
        rows.product(product_id)
    rows.leak("a", 14, "LEAK-1").retest("a").leak("a", 10, "LEAK-1").finish("a")
    rows.leak("b", 14, "LEAK-2")
    rows.leak("c", 10, "LEAK-3").finish("c")
    rows.leak("d", 14, "LEAK-3")
    return rows


def table_row(**fields):
    row = dict.fromkeys(INPUT_COLUMNS, "")
    row.update(id="PF-01", failure_type="record", process_step="ALL", function_requirement="f", failure_mode="m",
               effect="e", cause="c", prevention_control="없음", detection_control="없음")
    row.update(fields)
    return row


def write_table(path, rows, columns=INPUT_COLUMNS):
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=columns, extrasaction="ignore")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def run_cli(*arguments, cwd):
    environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT), PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "src.pfmea", *map(str, arguments)], cwd=cwd, env=environment,
                          capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8")

+def read_csv(path):
+    with Path(path).open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as f:
+        return list(csv.DictReader(f))
+
+
+def dump(path, data):
+    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
+    return Path(path)
+
+
+def cli(module, *args, cwd):
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', module, *map(str, args)], cwd=cwd,
+                          env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT), PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8',
+                                   PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
+
+
+def config_at(folder, **changes):
+    data = copy.deepcopy(CONFIG)
+    data.update(recipe=str(ROOT / 'recipes/lamp_models_measured.json'),
+                equipment=str(ROOT / 'recipes/equipment_measured.json'))
+    data.update(changes)
+    return dump(Path(folder) / 'generator.json', data)
+
+
+def event(pid, name, **fields):
+    result = dict.fromkeys(input_columns(BOOK, True), '')
+    result.update(seq='1', product_id=pid, event=name, **fields)
+    return result
+

+class Rig:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.table = modbus.Table()
+        self.controller = plc.Plc(self.table, station.load_station(ROOT / 'recipes/plc_station.json').timing)
+        self.set(clamp_open=True, guard_closed=True)
+
+    def set(self, **signals):
+        for key, value in signals.items():
+            self.table.discrete[plc.INPUTS.index(key)] = value
+
+    def scan(self, value=''):
+        self.table.holding[0] = (self.table.holding[0] + 1) % 65536
+        return self.controller.scan(value)
+
+    def publish(self):
+        for signals in (dict(part_present=True), dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True),
+                        dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True), dict(measure_done=True),
+                        dict(measure_done=False)):
+            self.set(**signals)
+            self.scan('-0.001')
+        assert self.controller.state == plc.WAIT_JUDGE
+

+    def test_p02_capability_restarts_remainders_independent(self):
+        segments = [[str(8 + i % 5) for i in range(129)], ['13'] * 4,
+                    [str(9 + i % 3) for i in range(131)]]
+        actual = capability.capability(segments, '7', '13')
+        with localcontext() as ctx:
+            ctx.prec = 100
+            values = [Decimal(v) for s in segments for v in s]
+            groups = [list(map(Decimal, s[i:i+5])) for s in segments for i in range(0, len(s)-4, 5)]
+            mean = sum(values) / len(values)
+            sd = (sum((v-mean)**2 for v in values) / (len(values)-1)).sqrt()
+            center = sum(sum(g)/5 for g in groups) / len(groups)
+            within = sum(max(g)-min(g) for g in groups) / len(groups) / Decimal('2.326')
+            self.assertEqual(actual.cpk, min(13-center, center-7)/(3*within))
+            self.assertEqual(actual.ppk, min(13-mean, mean-7)/(3*sd))
+            self.assertEqual((actual.n, actual.subgroups), (264, 51))

+    def test_p10_modbus_every_split_before_damage_and_pair_atomicity(self):
+        def frame(tid,pdu,protocol=0):
+            return struct.pack('>HHHB',tid,protocol,len(pdu)+1,1)+pdu
+        stream=frame(1,bytes.fromhex('0600000007'))+frame(2,bytes.fromhex('10000100020400010002'))
+        stream+=frame(3,bytes.fromhex('0600000009'),1)+frame(4,bytes.fromhex('060000000B'))
+        for cut in range(1,len(stream)):
+            b=modbus.FrameBuffer(); table=modbus.Table(); replies=[]
+            for chunk in (stream[:cut],stream[cut:]):
+                replies.extend(modbus.respond(f,table) for f in b.feed(chunk))
+                if b.damaged: break
+            self.assertEqual((table.holding[:3],len(replies)),([7,1,2],2))
+            before=list(table.holding)
+            self.assertEqual(modbus.handle_pdu(bytes.fromhex('100000000204000B000C'),table),b'\x90\x02')
+            self.assertEqual(table.holding,before)

+    def test_p11_modbus_total_response_deadline(self):
+        listener=socket.socket(); listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); listener.listen()
+        def serve():
+            conn,_=listener.accept()
+            with conn:
+                request=conn.recv(1024)
+                reply=request[:4]+struct.pack('>H',5)+b'\x01\x03\x02\x00\x07'
+                try:
+                    for byte in reply:
+                        time.sleep(.15)
+                        conn.sendall(bytes([byte]))
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+        worker=threading.Thread(target=serve,daemon=True); worker.start()
+        client=modbus.ModbusClient(listener.getsockname()[1],timeout=1.0)
+        start=time.monotonic()
+        try:
+            with self.assertRaises(modbus.ModbusTimeout):
+                client.read_registers(modbus.READ_HOLDING,0,1)
+        finally:
+            print('P11 total_response_seconds=%.3f'%(time.monotonic()-start),flush=True)
+            client.close(); worker.join(3); listener.close()

+"""Review 019: independent boundary and integration probes; writes only inside tempfile.
+
+Run: py -m unittest handoff/reviews/probes/test_probe_019.py
+The optional run_legacy_suite() only redirects subprocess 'py' to sys.executable
+in this process; it neither edits tests nor changes the machine configuration.
+"""
+import copy
+import csv
+from dataclasses import replace
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, localcontext
+from fractions import Fraction
+import io
+import json
+import math
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import socket
+import struct
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import time
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from src import anomaly, capability, generate, line, modbus, pfmea, plc, station
+from src.recipe_rules import RecipeProcess, input_columns
+from src.summary import build_analysis
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+SETTINGS = anomaly.load_settings(ROOT / 'recipes/anomaly_lamp.json')
+PROCESS = anomaly.load_process(SETTINGS)
+CONFIG, _, RECIPE, BOOK = generate.load_setup(ROOT / 'recipes/generator_measured.json')
+
+
+def read_csv(path):
+    with Path(path).open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as f:
+        return list(csv.DictReader(f))
+
+
+def dump(path, data):
+    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
+    return Path(path)
+
+
+def cli(module, *args, cwd):
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', module, *map(str, args)], cwd=cwd,
+                          env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT), PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8',
+                                   PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
+
+
+def config_at(folder, **changes):
+    data = copy.deepcopy(CONFIG)
+    data.update(recipe=str(ROOT / 'recipes/lamp_models_measured.json'),
+                equipment=str(ROOT / 'recipes/equipment_measured.json'))
+    data.update(changes)
+    return dump(Path(folder) / 'generator.json', data)
+
+
+def event(pid, name, **fields):
+    result = dict.fromkeys(input_columns(BOOK, True), '')
+    result.update(seq='1', product_id=pid, event=name, **fields)
+    return result
+
+
+class Rig:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.table = modbus.Table()
+        self.controller = plc.Plc(self.table, station.load_station(ROOT / 'recipes/plc_station.json').timing)
+        self.set(clamp_open=True, guard_closed=True)
+
+    def set(self, **signals):
+        for key, value in signals.items():
+            self.table.discrete[plc.INPUTS.index(key)] = value
+
+    def scan(self, value=''):
+        self.table.holding[0] = (self.table.holding[0] + 1) % 65536
+        return self.controller.scan(value)
+
+    def publish(self):
+        for signals in (dict(part_present=True), dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True),
+                        dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True), dict(measure_done=True),
+                        dict(measure_done=False)):
+            self.set(**signals)
+            self.scan('-0.001')
+        assert self.controller.state == plc.WAIT_JUDGE
+
+
+class Probe019(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_p01_rejection_then_valid_retest_preserves_state(self):
+        p = RecipeProcess(RECIPE.models, BOOK)
+        for pid in ('a', 'A'):
+            for row in (event(pid, 'REGISTER', model='B'), event(pid, 'P1'), event(pid, 'P2'),
+                        event(pid, 'INSPECT', inspection='LEAK', equipment='LEAK-1', value='14')):
+                self.assertTrue(p.apply(row).accepted)
+        self.assertTrue(p.apply(event('a', 'RETEST_REQUEST', inspection='LEAK')).accepted)
+        for value, equipment in (('', 'LEAK-2'), ('10', 'leak-2'), ('10', 'LEAK-1'), (' 10', 'LEAK-2')):
+            before = copy.deepcopy((p.products, p.equipment))
+            self.assertFalse(p.apply(event('a', 'INSPECT', inspection='LEAK', equipment=equipment, value=value)).accepted)
+            self.assertEqual((p.products, p.equipment), before)
+        self.assertTrue(p.apply(event('a', 'INSPECT', inspection='LEAK', equipment='LEAK-2', value='10.000')).accepted)
+        self.assertEqual(p.products['a'].inspections['LEAK'], 'PASS')
+        self.assertEqual(p.products['A'].inspections['LEAK'], 'FAIL')
+        self.assertEqual(len(p.equipment['LEAK-2'].recent_results), 0)
+
+    def test_p02_capability_restarts_remainders_independent(self):
+        segments = [[str(8 + i % 5) for i in range(129)], ['13'] * 4,
+                    [str(9 + i % 3) for i in range(131)]]
+        actual = capability.capability(segments, '7', '13')
+        with localcontext() as ctx:
+            ctx.prec = 100
+            values = [Decimal(v) for s in segments for v in s]
+            groups = [list(map(Decimal, s[i:i+5])) for s in segments for i in range(0, len(s)-4, 5)]
+            mean = sum(values) / len(values)
+            sd = (sum((v-mean)**2 for v in values) / (len(values)-1)).sqrt()
+            center = sum(sum(g)/5 for g in groups) / len(groups)
+            within = sum(max(g)-min(g) for g in groups) / len(groups) / Decimal('2.326')
+            self.assertEqual(actual.cpk, min(13-center, center-7)/(3*within))
+            self.assertEqual(actual.ppk, min(13-mean, mean-7)/(3*sd))
+            self.assertEqual((actual.n, actual.subgroups), (264, 51))
+
+    def test_p03_equal_numeric_specs_across_shared_loaders(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            recipe = json.loads((ROOT / 'recipes/lamp_models_measured.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+            for item in recipe['B']['inspections']:
+                item.update(lsl='7', usl='13')
+            path = config_at(td, recipe=str(dump(Path(td)/'recipe.json', recipe)))
+            generate.load_setup(path)  # the shared recipe contract explicitly accepts numeric equality
+            for name, loader in (
+                    ('anomaly', lambda: anomaly.load_process(replace(SETTINGS, generator=path))),
+                    ('station', lambda: station.load_values(replace(station.load_station(ROOT/'recipes/plc_station.json'),
+                                                                   generator=path), 42, 20))):
+                with self.subTest(loader=name):
+                    try:
+                        loader()
+                    except ValueError as error:
+                        self.fail('equal numeric specifications were rejected: ' + str(error))
+
+    def test_p04_generator_extreme_errors_and_rounding(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            for changes in (dict(process_cpk=.1, defect_shift_sigma=10**308, fault_shift_sigma={'LEAK-2':10**308}),
+                            dict(process_cpk=1e-307, error_rate=0)):
+                result = cli('src.generate', '--config', config_at(td, **changes), '--products', 20,
+                             '--out', Path(td)/'out.csv', cwd=td)
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
+                self.assertNotIn('Traceback', result.stderr)
+                self.assertFalse((Path(td)/'out.csv').exists())
+        for value, expected in ((-0.0005, '-0.001'), (1e-300, '0.000'), (13.0005, '13.001')):
+            self.assertEqual(generate.confirm_value(value), expected)
+
+    def test_p05_report_reference_missing_cell_and_empty(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            directory = Path(td)/'reports'; directory.mkdir()
+            path = directory/'probe.csv'
+            provenance = ''.join('provenance,'+name+',x,\n' for name in pfmea.REQUIRED_PROVENANCE)
+            for tail, accepted in (('method,m,x\n', False), ('method,m,x,\n', True)):
+                path.write_text('section,method,value,capture_rate\n'+provenance+tail, encoding='utf-8')
+                if accepted:
+                    self.assertEqual(pfmea.resolve_reference('report:probe:m:capture_rate', td).report[0], '')
+                else:
+                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                        pfmea.resolve_reference('report:probe:m:capture_rate', td)
+        self.assertEqual(pfmea.effect_result(Fraction(2, 3), '>=', '0.6666666666666666666666666667'), '미충족')
+
+    def test_p06_line_zero_buffer_repair_and_escape(self):
+        stages = [line.SimStation('M', 1, {'A':1000}), line.SimStation('I', 2, {'A':10000}, 'LEAK')]
+        routes = [line.Route(str(i), 'A', {'LEAK':1}, defective=i==0,
+                             stops=frozenset({'LEAK'}) if i<2 else frozenset()) for i in range(4)]
+        r = line.simulate(stages, routes, 0, 100000)
+        self.assertEqual((r.end, r.good, r.passed, r.escaped), (122000, 3, 4, 1))
+        self.assertEqual(line.uph(r.good, r.end), Fraction(10800000, 122000))
+        self.assertEqual((r.work['I'], r.repair['I']), (40000, 200000))
+
+    def test_p07_line_long_seconds_end_to_end(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:

+    def test_p10_modbus_every_split_before_damage_and_pair_atomicity(self):
+        def frame(tid,pdu,protocol=0):
+            return struct.pack('>HHHB',tid,protocol,len(pdu)+1,1)+pdu
+        stream=frame(1,bytes.fromhex('0600000007'))+frame(2,bytes.fromhex('10000100020400010002'))
+        stream+=frame(3,bytes.fromhex('0600000009'),1)+frame(4,bytes.fromhex('060000000B'))
+        for cut in range(1,len(stream)):
+            b=modbus.FrameBuffer(); table=modbus.Table(); replies=[]
+            for chunk in (stream[:cut],stream[cut:]):
+                replies.extend(modbus.respond(f,table) for f in b.feed(chunk))
+                if b.damaged: break
+            self.assertEqual((table.holding[:3],len(replies)),([7,1,2],2))
+            before=list(table.holding)
+            self.assertEqual(modbus.handle_pdu(bytes.fromhex('100000000204000B000C'),table),b'\x90\x02')
+            self.assertEqual(table.holding,before)
+
+    def test_p11_modbus_total_response_deadline(self):
+        listener=socket.socket(); listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); listener.listen()
+        def serve():
+            conn,_=listener.accept()
+            with conn:
+                request=conn.recv(1024)
+                reply=request[:4]+struct.pack('>H',5)+b'\x01\x03\x02\x00\x07'
+                try:
+                    for byte in reply:
+                        time.sleep(.15)
+                        conn.sendall(bytes([byte]))
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+        worker=threading.Thread(target=serve,daemon=True); worker.start()
+        client=modbus.ModbusClient(listener.getsockname()[1],timeout=1.0)
+        start=time.monotonic()
+        try:
+            with self.assertRaises(modbus.ModbusTimeout):
+                client.read_registers(modbus.READ_HOLDING,0,1)
+        finally:
+            print('P11 total_response_seconds=%.3f'%(time.monotonic()-start),flush=True)
+            client.close(); worker.join(3); listener.close()
+

+    def test_p15_model_csv_replay_independent_probability(self):
+        entries=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_model.csv')
+        model={(r['section'],r['name']):r['value'] for r in entries}
+        replay=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_replay.csv')
+        worst=0
+        for row in replay:
+            raw=list(map(float,row['window_values'].split()))
+            x=[(v-PROCESS.center)/PROCESS.sigma for v in raw]; n=len(x); mean=sum(x)/n
+            features=[mean,math.sqrt(sum((v-mean)**2 for v in x)/(n-1)),max(x),
+                      sum((i-(n-1)/2)*v for i,v in enumerate(x))/sum((i-(n-1)/2)**2 for i in range(n)),
+                      .2*x[-1]+.8*float(row['ewma_prev']),sum(v<7 or v>13 for v in raw)/n]
+            z=float(model['bias','bias'])
+            for name,value in zip(anomaly.FEATURES,features):
+                z+=(value-float(model['mean',name]))/float(model['scale',name])*float(model['weight',name])
+            probability=1/(1+math.exp(-z)); error=abs(probability-float(row['p'])); worst=max(worst,error)
+            self.assertLess(error,1e-9)
+        print('P15 replay_rows=%d max_probability_error=%.12g'%(len(replay),worst),flush=True)

+    def test_p16_submitted_anomaly_metrics_independent(self):
+        model={(r['section'],r['name']):r['value'] for r in read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_model.csv')}
+        report=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_methods.csv')
+        for split in ('validation','holdout'):
+            scenarios=anomaly.build_split(SETTINGS.splits[split],SETTINGS,PROCESS)
+            for method in anomaly.METHODS:
+                target=next(r for r in report if r['section']==split and r['method']==method)
+                threshold=Decimal(target['threshold']) if target['threshold'] else None
+                detected=early=missed=exposure=false=cost=suspect=alarms=0
+                for s in scenarios:
+                    alarm=None
+                    for index,features in enumerate(s.features):
+                        t=index+9
+                        if method=='rule_3_2':
+                            hit=sum(s.fails[max(0,t-2):t+1])>=2
+                        else:
+                            score=features[0]
+                            if method=='logistic':
+                                z=float(model['bias','bias'])
+                                for name,value in zip(anomaly.FEATURES,features):
+                                    z+=(value-float(model['mean',name]))/float(model['scale',name])*float(model['weight',name])
+                                score=1/(1+math.exp(-z))
+                            hit=Decimal(repr(score)).quantize(Decimal('.0001'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)>=threshold
+                        if hit:
+                            alarm=t; break
+                    alarms+=alarm is not None
+                    normal_end=399 if s.onset is None else s.onset-1
+                    exposure+=max(0,min(normal_end,alarm if alarm is not None else 399)-9+1)
+                    false+=alarm is not None and (s.onset is None or alarm<s.onset)
+                    if s.onset is not None:
+                        if alarm is None:
+                            missed+=1; cost+=400-s.onset; suspect+=400-s.onset
+                        elif alarm<s.onset:
+                            early+=1; cost+=400-s.onset; suspect+=400-s.onset
+                        else:
+                            detected+=1; cost+=alarm-s.onset; suspect+=alarm-s.onset+1
+                fmt=lambda n,d: format((Decimal(n)/Decimal(d)).quantize(Decimal('.0001'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP),'f')
+                self.assertEqual((target['detection_rate'],target['early'],target['missed'],target['mean_delay_cost'],target['false_per_1000']),
+                                 (fmt(detected,120),str(early),str(missed),fmt(cost,120),fmt(false*1000,exposure)))
+                if split=='holdout':
+                    policy=next(r for r in report if r['section']=='policy' and r['method']==method)
+                    self.assertEqual((policy['suspect_output'],policy['stop_minutes']),(fmt(suspect,120),fmt(alarms*10000,240)))
+                print('P16',split,method,'detected',detected,'cost',cost,'false/exposure',false,exposure,flush=True)

+    def test_p17_submitted_capability_from_measurement_rows(self):
+        events=read_csv(ROOT/'data/generated/gen_measured_seed42.csv')
+        analysis=build_analysis(events,RECIPE.models,BOOK)

+                    # first occurrence per product/inspection, independent of capability.equipment_segments

+                               r.seq==e['seq'] for r in analysis.all_inspections):
+                        segments[-1].append(Decimal(e['value']))
+            values=[v for s in segments for v in s]
+            groups=[s[i:i+5] for s in segments for i in range(0,len(s)-4,5)]
+            self.assertEqual((int(target['n']),int(target['subgroups'])),(len(values),len(groups)))
+            if len(groups)<25: continue
+            with localcontext() as ctx:
+                ctx.prec=100
+                center=sum(sum(g)/5 for g in groups)/len(groups)
+                within=sum(max(g)-min(g) for g in groups)/len(groups)/Decimal('2.326')
+                mean=sum(values)/len(values)
+                sd=(sum((x-mean)**2 for x in values)/(len(values)-1)).sqrt()
+                fmt=lambda x: format(x.quantize(Decimal('.0001'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP),'f')
+                self.assertEqual((target['cpk'],target['ppk']),(fmt(min(13-center,center-7)/(3*within)),fmt(min(13-mean,mean-7)/(3*sd))))
+        print('P17 independent capability rows=',len(report),flush=True)

## 레시피 규격
검사 항목에 `lsl`, `usl`, `unit`을 추가한다.

```json
{"id": "LEAK", "after": "P2", "lsl": null, "usl": "13.000", "unit": "가상 단위"}
```

위반은 모두 종료 코드 3이며 위치를 표시한다.
- 어떤 검사 항목이든 규격을 쓰면 **레시피의 모든 검사 항목**에 세 키가 다 있어야 한다.
- `lsl`, `usl`은 `null` 또는 문자열 소수다. 형식은 `^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$`이고, 부호와 소수점을 뺀 숫자는 30자리 이하다. 숫자형 JSON, 지수 표기, `NaN`, `Infinity`는 거절한다.
- 둘 다 `null`이면 오류다. 둘 다 있으면 `lsl < usl`이어야 한다.
- `unit`은 공백만 있지 않은 문자열이다.
- **같은 검사 ID는 모델이 달라도 규격과 단위가 같아야 한다.** Cpk 묶음이 하나의 규격을 갖게 하기 위해서다.

## 측정 입력
`INSPECT`에서만 `value`를 쓴다. 형식은 자릿수 상한을 포함해 규격과 같고, `Decimal`로 정확히 비교한다. `13`과 `13.000`은 같은 값이다. 입력값은 반올림하지 않고 원문을 보존한다.

판정: 있는 쪽 규격만 보고 `lsl <= value <= usl`이면 PASS, 아니면 FAIL이다. 경계값은 PASS다. 이 판정은 `src/recipe_rules.py`의 공통 함수 하나로 두고 판정기와 생성기가 함께 쓴다.

def _row(columns, section, **fields):
    return {column: fields.get(column, section if column == "section" else "") for column in columns}


def balance_rows(line, ratios, heuristic, optimal, visits, good_rate):
    takt = takt_of(line)
    manual = [element for element in line.elements if not element.inspection]
    inspections = sum(element.inspection for element in line.elements)
    lower = manual_bound(line.elements, line.net, line.demand)

    def summary(key, value):
        return _row(BALANCE_COLUMNS, "summary", key=key, value=value)

    rows = [_row(BALANCE_COLUMNS, "notice", text=text) for text in (ASSUMPTION_NOTICE, SYNTHETIC_NOTICE, ROUTE_NOTICE)]
    rows += [summary("net_seconds", show(Fraction(line.net, 1000))), summary("takt_seconds", show(takt / 1000)),
             summary("target_uph", show(target_uph(line))), summary("manual_lower_bound", lower),
             summary("station_lower_bound", lower + inspections),
             summary("heuristic_stations", len(heuristic.stations) if heuristic else NO_BALANCE),
             summary("optimal_stations", len(optimal.stations) if optimal else NO_BALANCE)]
    if heuristic and optimal:
        weighted = sum(ratio * element.times.get(model, 0) for element in manual for model, ratio in ratios.items())
        rows += [summary("gap", len(heuristic.stations) - len(optimal.stations)),
                 summary("manual_balance_rate", show(weighted / (optimal.manual_count * takt)))]
    by_id = {element.id: element for element in line.elements}
    for section, balance in (("heuristic", heuristic), ("optimal", optimal)):
        if balance is None:
            continue
        for number, members in enumerate(balance.stations, 1):
            for model in ratios:
                load = sum(by_id[name].times.get(model, 0) for name in members)
                rows.append(_row(
                    BALANCE_COLUMNS, section, station="S" + str(number), elements=",".join(members), model=model,
                    load_seconds=show(Fraction(load, 1000)),
                    idle_seconds="" if by_id[members[0]].inspection else show(takt / 1000 - Fraction(load, 1000))))
    if optimal is None:
        return rows
    for name in line.machines:
        rows.append(_row(BALANCE_COLUMNS, "visit", key=name, value=show(visits[name])))
    rows.append(_row(BALANCE_COLUMNS, "visit", key="good_rate", value=show(good_rate)))
    for name, machine in line.machines.items():
        element = next(item for item in line.elements if item.step == name)
        time = max(element.times.values())
        fixed = machine.load + machine.clamp + machine.unload
        for count in machine.counts:
            limits = cycle_limits(takt, count, visits[name], good_rate)
            fields = dict(가상검사시간=show(Fraction(time, 1000)),
                          자동구간=show(Fraction(machine.clamp + machine.test, 1000)),
                          점유면적=count * machine.width * (machine.depth + machine.service))
            if limits is None:
                fields.update(명목상한=NO_TARGET, 양품보정상한=NO_TARGET)
            else:
                nominal, adjusted = limits
                fields.update(
                    명목상한=show(nominal / 1000), 양품보정상한=show(adjusted / 1000),
                    양품보정허용test=show((adjusted - fixed) / 1000),
                    충족="손실 미반영 명목 조건 충족" if time <= nominal else "명목 조건 미충족",
                    양품보정="양품 보정 조건 충족" if time <= adjusted else "양품 보정 조건 미충족")
            rows.append(_row(BALANCE_COLUMNS, "spec", key=name + ":" + str(count),
                             text="".join(key + "=" + str(value) + ";" for key, value in fields.items())))
    return rows


def _rate_fields(total):
    return dict(pass_uph=show(uph(total.passed, total.end)), good_uph=show(uph(total.good, total.end)),
                escaped=total.escaped, mean_wait_seconds=show(Fraction(total.wait, 1000 * total.left)))


def _share(amount, servers, end):
    return Fraction(amount, servers * end) if end else Fraction(0)


def bottleneck_of(stations, total):
    best = max(_share(total.work[station.id], station.servers, total.end) for station in stations)
    return next(station.id for station in stations
                if _share(total.work[station.id], station.servers, total.end) == best)


def run_combo(line, balance, combo, seed_routes):
    stations = build_stations(line, balance, combo)
    total = SimResult()
    for routes in seed_routes:
        total.add(simulate(stations, routes, line.buffer_units, line.repair))
    return stations, total


def machine_order(line):
    """동률 키와 조합 표기의 순서다. 입력 파일의 키 순서와 무관하다."""
    fixed = [name for name in ("LEAK", "LIGHT", "FINAL") if name in line.machines]
    return fixed + sorted(set(line.machines) - set(fixed))


def compare(line, balance, seed_text, holdout_text, products, dev_routes, holdout_routes):
    names = machine_order(line)
    target = target_uph(line)
    meets_takt = _manual_fit(line, balance)
    rows = [_row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "notice", value=text) for text in (COMPARE_NOTICE, SYNTHETIC_NOTICE, ROUTE_NOTICE)]
    results, candidates, station_rows = {}, [], []
    combos = [dict(zip(names, counts)) for counts in combinations_of(*(line.machines[name].counts for name in names))]
    for combo in combos:
        stations, total = run_combo(line, balance, combo, dev_routes)
        layout = layout_of(line, balance, combo)
        passes_uph = uph(total.good, total.end) >= target
        passed = passes_uph and meets_takt and layout["meets_floor"]
        key = tuple(combo[name] for name in names)
        results[key] = (combo, stations, total, layout, passes_uph)
        candidates.append((area_of(line, combo), sum(combo.values()), key, passed))
    selected = select_combo(candidates)
    for key, (combo, stations, total, layout, passes_uph) in results.items():
        label = "-".join(str(count) for count in key)
        reasons = [name for name, good in (("uph", passes_uph), ("takt", meets_takt), ("floor", layout["meets_floor"]))
                   if not good]
        rows.append(_row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "development", combo=label, leak=combo.get("LEAK", ""),
                         light=combo.get("LIGHT", ""), final=combo.get("FINAL", ""), area_mm2=area_of(line, combo),
                         seeds=seed_text, products=products, bottleneck=bottleneck_of(stations, total),
                         meets_uph=passes_uph, meets_takt=meets_takt, meets_floor=layout["meets_floor"],
                         reject_reason=";".join(reasons), selected="선택" if key == selected else "",
                         **_rate_fields(total)))
        for station in stations:
            station_rows.append(_row(
                COMPARE_COLUMNS, "station", combo=label, seeds=seed_text, products=products, station=station.id,
                utilization=show(_share(total.work[station.id], station.servers, total.end)),
                blocked_share=show(_share(total.blocked[station.id], station.servers, total.end)),
                repair_share=show(_share(total.repair[station.id], station.servers, total.end))))
    rows += station_rows
    uph_value = None
    if selected is not None:
        combo = results[selected][0]
        stations, total = run_combo(line, balance, combo, holdout_routes)
        uph_value = uph(total.good, total.end)
        rows.append(_row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "holdout", combo="-".join(map(str, selected)), leak=combo.get("LEAK", ""),
                         light=combo.get("LIGHT", ""), final=combo.get("FINAL", ""), seeds=holdout_text,
                         products=products, bottleneck=bottleneck_of(stations, total),
                         meets_uph=uph_value >= target, **_rate_fields(total)))
    rows.append(_row(COMPARE_COLUMNS, "selection", combo="-".join(map(str, selected)) if selected else "",
                     value=(NO_COMBO if selected is None else "선택") + " / " + holdout_result(
                         selected, uph_value, target)))
    return rows, selected, results, candidates

+        return self.controller.scan(value)
+
+    def publish(self):
+        for signals in (dict(part_present=True), dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True),
+                        dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True), dict(measure_done=True),
+                        dict(measure_done=False)):
+            self.set(**signals)
+            self.scan('-0.001')
+        assert self.controller.state == plc.WAIT_JUDGE
+

+    def test_p02_capability_restarts_remainders_independent(self):
+        segments = [[str(8 + i % 5) for i in range(129)], ['13'] * 4,
+                    [str(9 + i % 3) for i in range(131)]]
+        actual = capability.capability(segments, '7', '13')
+        with localcontext() as ctx:
+            ctx.prec = 100
+            values = [Decimal(v) for s in segments for v in s]
+            groups = [list(map(Decimal, s[i:i+5])) for s in segments for i in range(0, len(s)-4, 5)]
+            mean = sum(values) / len(values)
+            sd = (sum((v-mean)**2 for v in values) / (len(values)-1)).sqrt()
+            center = sum(sum(g)/5 for g in groups) / len(groups)
+            within = sum(max(g)-min(g) for g in groups) / len(groups) / Decimal('2.326')
+            self.assertEqual(actual.cpk, min(13-center, center-7)/(3*within))
+            self.assertEqual(actual.ppk, min(13-mean, mean-7)/(3*sd))
+            self.assertEqual((actual.n, actual.subgroups), (264, 51))

+    def test_p10_modbus_every_split_before_damage_and_pair_atomicity(self):
+        def frame(tid,pdu,protocol=0):
+            return struct.pack('>HHHB',tid,protocol,len(pdu)+1,1)+pdu
+        stream=frame(1,bytes.fromhex('0600000007'))+frame(2,bytes.fromhex('10000100020400010002'))
+        stream+=frame(3,bytes.fromhex('0600000009'),1)+frame(4,bytes.fromhex('060000000B'))
+        for cut in range(1,len(stream)):
+            b=modbus.FrameBuffer(); table=modbus.Table(); replies=[]
+            for chunk in (stream[:cut],stream[cut:]):
+                replies.extend(modbus.respond(f,table) for f in b.feed(chunk))
+                if b.damaged: break
+            self.assertEqual((table.holding[:3],len(replies)),([7,1,2],2))
+            before=list(table.holding)
+            self.assertEqual(modbus.handle_pdu(bytes.fromhex('100000000204000B000C'),table),b'\x90\x02')
+            self.assertEqual(table.holding,before)
+
+    def test_p11_modbus_total_response_deadline(self):
+        listener=socket.socket(); listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); listener.listen()
+        def serve():
+            conn,_=listener.accept()
+            with conn:
+                request=conn.recv(1024)
+                reply=request[:4]+struct.pack('>H',5)+b'\x01\x03\x02\x00\x07'
+                try:
+                    for byte in reply:
+                        time.sleep(.15)
+                        conn.sendall(bytes([byte]))
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+        worker=threading.Thread(target=serve,daemon=True); worker.start()
+        client=modbus.ModbusClient(listener.getsockname()[1],timeout=1.0)
+        start=time.monotonic()
+        try:
+            with self.assertRaises(modbus.ModbusTimeout):
+                client.read_registers(modbus.READ_HOLDING,0,1)
+        finally:
+            print('P11 total_response_seconds=%.3f'%(time.monotonic()-start),flush=True)
+            client.close(); worker.join(3); listener.close()
+

+    def test_p15_model_csv_replay_independent_probability(self):
+        entries=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_model.csv')
+        model={(r['section'],r['name']):r['value'] for r in entries}
+        replay=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_replay.csv')
+        worst=0
+        for row in replay:
+            raw=list(map(float,row['window_values'].split()))
+            x=[(v-PROCESS.center)/PROCESS.sigma for v in raw]; n=len(x); mean=sum(x)/n
+            features=[mean,math.sqrt(sum((v-mean)**2 for v in x)/(n-1)),max(x),
+                      sum((i-(n-1)/2)*v for i,v in enumerate(x))/sum((i-(n-1)/2)**2 for i in range(n)),
+                      .2*x[-1]+.8*float(row['ewma_prev']),sum(v<7 or v>13 for v in raw)/n]
+            z=float(model['bias','bias'])
+            for name,value in zip(anomaly.FEATURES,features):
+                z+=(value-float(model['mean',name]))/float(model['scale',name])*float(model['weight',name])
+            probability=1/(1+math.exp(-z)); error=abs(probability-float(row['p'])); worst=max(worst,error)
+            self.assertLess(error,1e-9)
+        print('P15 replay_rows=%d max_probability_error=%.12g'%(len(replay),worst),flush=True)

+    def test_p16_submitted_anomaly_metrics_independent(self):
+        model={(r['section'],r['name']):r['value'] for r in read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_model.csv')}
+        report=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/anomaly_lamp_methods.csv')
+        for split in ('validation','holdout'):
+            scenarios=anomaly.build_split(SETTINGS.splits[split],SETTINGS,PROCESS)
+            for method in anomaly.METHODS:
+                target=next(r for r in report if r['section']==split and r['method']==method)
+                threshold=Decimal(target['threshold']) if target['threshold'] else None
+                detected=early=missed=exposure=false=cost=suspect=alarms=0
+                for s in scenarios:
+                    alarm=None
+                    for index,features in enumerate(s.features):
+                        t=index+9
+                        if method=='rule_3_2':
+                            hit=sum(s.fails[max(0,t-2):t+1])>=2
+                        else:
+                            score=features[0]
+                            if method=='logistic':
+                                z=float(model['bias','bias'])
+                                for name,value in zip(anomaly.FEATURES,features):
+                                    z+=(value-float(model['mean',name]))/float(model['scale',name])*float(model['weight',name])
+                                score=1/(1+math.exp(-z))
+                            hit=Decimal(repr(score)).quantize(Decimal('.0001'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)>=threshold
+                        if hit:
+                            alarm=t; break
+                    alarms+=alarm is not None
+                    normal_end=399 if s.onset is None else s.onset-1
+                    exposure+=max(0,min(normal_end,alarm if alarm is not None else 399)-9+1)
+                    false+=alarm is not None and (s.onset is None or alarm<s.onset)
+                    if s.onset is not None:
+                        if alarm is None:
+                            missed+=1; cost+=400-s.onset; suspect+=400-s.onset
+                        elif alarm<s.onset:
+                            early+=1; cost+=400-s.onset; suspect+=400-s.onset
+                        else:
+                            detected+=1; cost+=alarm-s.onset; suspect+=alarm-s.onset+1
+                fmt=lambda n,d: format((Decimal(n)/Decimal(d)).quantize(Decimal('.0001'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP),'f')
+                self.assertEqual((target['detection_rate'],target['early'],target['missed'],target['mean_delay_cost'],target['false_per_1000']),
+                                 (fmt(detected,120),str(early),str(missed),fmt(cost,120),fmt(false*1000,exposure)))
+                if split=='holdout':
+                    policy=next(r for r in report if r['section']=='policy' and r['method']==method)
+                    self.assertEqual((policy['suspect_output'],policy['stop_minutes']),(fmt(suspect,120),fmt(alarms*10000,240)))
+                print('P16',split,method,'detected',detected,'cost',cost,'false/exposure',false,exposure,flush=True)
+

+    def test_p19_pfmea_counts_from_raw_runs(self):
+        totals={name:[0,0] for name in pfmea.METRICS}
+        for seed in range(30):
+            g=generate.Generator(seed,CONFIG,RECIPE.models,BOOK)
+            analysis=build_analysis(g.normal_events(500),RECIPE.models,BOOK)
+            bad=set(g.defective_products); faulty=set(CONFIG['fault_shift_sigma'])
+            products=analysis.process.products
+            first={}
+            attempts={}
+            stopped={name:[] for name in BOOK.equipment}
+            for index,(e,d) in enumerate(zip(analysis.events,analysis.decisions),1):
+                if not d.accepted or e['event']!='INSPECT': continue
+                key=(e['product_id'],e['inspection'])
+                attempts.setdefault(key,[]).append((e['equipment'],e['value'],index))
+                first.setdefault(key,(e['equipment'],e['value'],index))
+            for s in analysis.stop_history: stopped[s.equipment].append(s.row_index)
+            update=lambda key,n,d: (totals[key].__setitem__(0,totals[key][0]+n),totals[key].__setitem__(1,totals[key][1]+d))
+            update('defect_escape',sum(products[p].status==pfmea.COMPLETED for p in bad),len(bad))
+            normal=set(products)-bad
+            update('normal_reject',sum(products[p].status in ('보류','폐기') for p in normal),len(normal))
+            for metric,inspection in (('all_defect_first_fail',None),('leak_defect_first_fail','LEAK')):
+                observations=[v for (p,i),(eq,v,idx) in first.items() if p in bad and (inspection is None or i==inspection)]
+                update(metric,sum(Decimal(v)<7 or Decimal(v)>13 for v in observations),len(observations))
+            retested=[values for (p,i),values in attempts.items() if p in bad and i=='LEAK' and len(values)>1]
+            update('leak_defect_retest_pass',sum(7<=Decimal(values[-1][1])<=13 for values in retested),len(retested))
+            found=[name for name in faulty if stopped[name]]
+            update('fault_stop_run',len(found),len(faulty)); update('fault_no_stop_run',len(faulty)-len(found),len(faulty))
+            update('fault_stop_delay',sum(sum(eq==name and index<=stopped[name][0] for eq,v,index in first.values()) for name in found),len(found))
+            update('normal_stop_rate',sum(len(stops) for name,stops in stopped.items() if name not in faulty),
+                   sum(eq not in faulty for eq,v,index in first.values()))
+        report=read_csv(ROOT/'reports/pfmea_lamp_report.csv')
+        for row in report:
+            if row['section']=='metric':
+                name=row['reference'].split(':')[1]
+                self.assertEqual(totals[name],[int(row['numerator']),int(row['denominator'])])
+        print('P19 PFMEA raw totals='+repr(totals),flush=True)

+        plan=line.load_line(ROOT/'recipes/line_lamp.json',RECIPE.models)
+        weights={k:Fraction(str(v)) for k,v in CONFIG['model_weights'].items()}

+        combo={'LEAK':2,'LIGHT':1,'FINAL':1}

+                r=line.simulate(stages,routes,plan.buffer_units,plan.repair)

+                good+=sum(route.completed and not route.defective for route in routes)
+                passed+=sum(route.completed for route in routes)

## 명세 이견과 Claude 의견 수용

**T143의 산술 반박을 받아들인다.** tasks.md:236의 기대표는 pass_uph=180, good_uph=90이지만 서비스 10초·서버 1개·완료 제품 2개이면 종료는 20초다. 정의대로 2×3600/20=360, 1×3600/20=180이다. P11은 종료·완료 수·양품 수·유출 수를 함께 확인해 Claude의 계산을 지지했다. 정의를 따르는 구현과 테스트에 수정 요구를 추가하지 않는다. 기대표는 고치지 않았으며, 표와 정의의 모순은 이 명세 이견으로 남긴다.

tasks.md:95의 “어떤 요소가 택트를 넘으면”을 검사 요소까지 포함해 문자 그대로 읽으면 기본 LEAK 34초 > 택트 19.8462초인 T131의 정상 최적 배치와 양립하지 않는다. 이번 검수는 :90의 수작업 제약·검사기 병렬 대수 정의·T131을 함께 읽어 수작업 요소에 대한 제한으로 해석했다. 이는 명세의 범위 표현 누락이며, 기본 검사 요소를 배치 불가로 바꾸라는 요구가 아니다. 명세를 직접 수정하지 않았다.

후보들의 품질 경로를 다시 생성하지 않는 조건부 용량 비교라는 설명, 중복 손실 반영을 피한 정의, 서버를 떠나는 순간 수리를 시작한다는 설명은 코드와 P09·P10·P15에 부합한다. 9-1~9-3을 한 구현 커밋으로 묶었다는 절차 차이는 공개되어 있고 별도의 동작 수정 요구로 세지 않는다.

+
+H1은 기존에 유효한 측정 설정의 거절, H2는 명시한 시간 초과 처리의 우회, H3은 허용 입력의 정확한 보고 계약 위반을 근거로 높음이다. 기본 제출 설정에서 재현되지 않는다는 사실이나 수정 비용·일정으로 심각도를 낮추지 않았다. M1은 잘못된 판정 접수나 제품 상태 변경이 아니라 기록 불일치다.

+## 사전 기준·분리·명세 이견
+
+- 지정 범위 `git log bb73241..HEAD`, `git diff bb73241..HEAD`의 코드·테스트·설정·보고서·README·handoff 기록을 대조했다. 명세 확정 커밋은 순서대로 `314a909`, `4daa65a`, `3616dad`, `7e9f623`, `4f3f153`이며 각 구현보다 앞선다. tasks.md는 이 다섯 확정 커밋에서만 바뀌었다. `4f3f153..HEAD`의 tasks.md diff는 없다. 확인한 저장소 이력에서는 **결과를 본 뒤 기준을 완화한 흔적이 없다**. 커밋 밖에서 언제 어떤 실험을 봤는지까지 입증하는 주장은 하지 않는다.
+- PF-01/02/06의 0.80/0.95/0.90, 라인의 개발 양품 UPH·택트·바닥→면적/총 대수/조합 순 선택, 이상 검출의 오탐 2·전체 0.90·이동량 0.70→지연 비용 순 선택이 코드와 제출물에서 유지된다. PF-02·PF-06 미달, 로지스틱 수렴 미달도 숨기지 않는다.
+- `anomaly.run`은 train만 `fit_model`에 넣는다. 표준화·가중치에 validation/holdout이 들어가는 경로는 발견하지 못했다. 임계값은 validation의 양자화 점수로 고르고, 방법 선택도 validation 지표만 사용한다. holdout 지표를 계산하는 코드가 선택 호출보다 앞에 있지만 선택 입력에 섞이지 않으며 P13에서 실제 변경을 통해 확인했다.
+- 라인은 holdout 경로를 미리 생성하지만 `compare`의 선택에는 dev_routes만 사용한다. 선택 후 한 조합만 holdout에서 확인하며 다시 고르지 않는다. 미리 읽는 실행 순서와 선택 자료로 쓰는 것은 구분했다.
+- T143은 기대표의 180/90이 산술 오류라는 Claude 해석에 동의한다. 10초×2제품=20초, 검사합격 2×3600/20=360, 양품 1×3600/20=180이다. 기대표를 고치지 않았다. 수리·재검사·수율·계획 정지의 중복 반영도 찾지 못했다.
+- **낮음 L1 / `handoff/tasks.md:156` / 문제:** “조기 경보면 경보 행 하나”는 여전히 너무 넓은 문장이다. **근거:** decisions의 공식 우선 해석과 달리 onset−1은 5행이다(P14). **제안:** 추후 설명을 onset−5 이하/이전 경계에 맞춰 정리한다. 이 리뷰는 사용자가 기준으로 지정한 decisions의 해석을 수용하므로 별도의 미해결 중간으로 중복 계상하지 않는다. 사용자 최종 승인 여부를 검수자가 바꾼 것은 아니다.

+README 7a의 설비별 표, 8단계 지표·조치·대안 표, 9단계 12조합 표와 선택·홀드아웃, 10단계 8시나리오, 11단계 6방법행·정책·수렴 문장을 제출 보고서와 대조했다. 이 표들에서 수치 불일치는 찾지 못했다. 7a의 491/6/3 및 결함 6개 설명도 제품 보고서·meta와 부합한다. “합성”, “가상”, “소프트웨어 모의”, “실무/실제 설비/CAD/예지보전 아님”이 각 절에 명시돼 있다. README에 공고의 기술 요건이나 SL 실제 공정 사실을 추가로 단정한 문장은 발견하지 못했다. 채용 공고 원문과 실제 장비 동작을 검증한 것은 아니다.

+초기 검수 반례의 P01은 장비 창 필드명을 `window`로 잘못 참조했고 `recent_results`로 바로잡았다. 초기 P03은 원본과 같은 표기를 넣어 변화를 만들지 못해 B를 `7/13`으로 수정했다. 이 두 검수 코드 오류는 제품 결함으로 세지 않았다. 마지막 실행의 실패 5항목은 위 네 지적과 정확히 대응한다.
+
+## 실행·보존 기록
+
+`handoff/setup-notes.md`를 먼저 읽었고 tasks·decisions·gpt-log의 7a–11 및 014–018 수정 기록을 확인했다. `docs/`의 옛 명세를 기준으로 사용하지 않았다. `practical-work-operation`은 조율·보존에만 적용했다. 사용자 지시대로 플러그인 리뷰 스킬과 보조 에이전트는 사용하지 않았다.
+
+`git diff --check bb73241..HEAD -- src tests recipes README.md`는 출력 없이 종료 0. 전체 범위 diff-check는 과거 loop-logs의 공백 경고로 종료 1이며 제품 코드 결함으로 계상하지 않았다. 시작부터 있던 `handoff/loop-logs/019-codex.txt`는 검수 루프 소유 파일로 건드리지 않았다. 이번 검수의 저장소 쓰기는 이 리뷰와 `probes/test_probe_019.py` 두 파일뿐이다. 커밋·푸시·설치·원본 수정·저장소 파일 삭제를 하지 않았다.
+
+기존 보호 파일의 blob 비교와 보조 전체 테스트는 통과했다. 7a 이후 각 단계의 원래 테스트에 들어간 변경은 이전 리뷰에 따른 수정이며, 새 단계가 앞 단계 테스트를 임의로 고친 흔적은 확인되지 않았다. Python 3.9와 사용자 PC의 `py` 정상 연결 환경은 이 세션에서 미검증이다.

+def read_csv(path):
+    with Path(path).open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as f:
+        return list(csv.DictReader(f))
+
+
+def dump(path, data):
+    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
+    return Path(path)
+
+
+def cli(module, *args, cwd):
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', module, *map(str, args)], cwd=cwd,
+                          env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT), PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8',
+                                   PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
+
+
+def config_at(folder, **changes):
+    data = copy.deepcopy(CONFIG)
+    data.update(recipe=str(ROOT / 'recipes/lamp_models_measured.json'),
+                equipment=str(ROOT / 'recipes/equipment_measured.json'))
+    data.update(changes)
+    return dump(Path(folder) / 'generator.json', data)
+
+
+def event(pid, name, **fields):
+    result = dict.fromkeys(input_columns(BOOK, True), '')
+    result.update(seq='1', product_id=pid, event=name, **fields)
+    return result
+
+
+class Rig:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.table = modbus.Table()
+        self.controller = plc.Plc(self.table, station.load_station(ROOT / 'recipes/plc_station.json').timing)
+        self.set(clamp_open=True, guard_closed=True)
+
+    def set(self, **signals):
+        for key, value in signals.items():
+            self.table.discrete[plc.INPUTS.index(key)] = value
+
+    def scan(self, value=''):
+        self.table.holding[0] = (self.table.holding[0] + 1) % 65536
+        return self.controller.scan(value)
+
+    def publish(self):
+        for signals in (dict(part_present=True), dict(seated=True, direction_ok=True),
+                        dict(clamp_open=False, clamp_closed=True), dict(measure_done=True),
+                        dict(measure_done=False)):
+            self.set(**signals)
+            self.scan('-0.001')
+        assert self.controller.state == plc.WAIT_JUDGE
+

+    def test_p02_capability_restarts_remainders_independent(self):
+        segments = [[str(8 + i % 5) for i in range(129)], ['13'] * 4,
+                    [str(9 + i % 3) for i in range(131)]]
+        actual = capability.capability(segments, '7', '13')
+        with localcontext() as ctx:
+            ctx.prec = 100
+            values = [Decimal(v) for s in segments for v in s]
+            groups = [list(map(Decimal, s[i:i+5])) for s in segments for i in range(0, len(s)-4, 5)]
+            mean = sum(values) / len(values)
+            sd = (sum((v-mean)**2 for v in values) / (len(values)-1)).sqrt()
+            center = sum(sum(g)/5 for g in groups) / len(groups)
+            within = sum(max(g)-min(g) for g in groups) / len(groups) / Decimal('2.326')
+            self.assertEqual(actual.cpk, min(13-center, center-7)/(3*within))
+            self.assertEqual(actual.ppk, min(13-mean, mean-7)/(3*sd))
+            self.assertEqual((actual.n, actual.subgroups), (264, 51))

+    def test_p10_modbus_every_split_before_damage_and_pair_atomicity(self):
+        def frame(tid,pdu,protocol=0):
+            return struct.pack('>HHHB',tid,protocol,len(pdu)+1,1)+pdu
+        stream=frame(1,bytes.fromhex('0600000007'))+frame(2,bytes.fromhex('10000100020400010002'))
+        stream+=frame(3,bytes.fromhex('0600000009'),1)+frame(4,bytes.fromhex('060000000B'))
+        for cut in range(1,len(stream)):
+            b=modbus.FrameBuffer(); table=modbus.Table(); replies=[]
+            for chunk in (stream[:cut],stream[cut:]):
+                replies.extend(modbus.respond(f,table) for f in b.feed(chunk))
+                if b.damaged: break
+            self.assertEqual((table.holding[:3],len(replies)),([7,1,2],2))
+            before=list(table.holding)
+            self.assertEqual(modbus.handle_pdu(bytes.fromhex('100000000204000B000C'),table),b'\x90\x02')
+            self.assertEqual(table.holding,before)

+            with conn:

+                reply=request[:4]+struct.pack('>H',5)+b'\x01\x03\x02\x00\x07'
+                try:
+                    for byte in reply:
+                        time.sleep(.15)
+                        conn.sendall(bytes([byte]))
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+        worker=threading.Thread(target=serve,daemon=True); worker.start()
+        client=modbus.ModbusClient(listener.getsockname()[1],timeout=1.0)
+        start=time.monotonic()
+        try:
+            with self.assertRaises(modbus.ModbusTimeout):
+                client.read_registers(modbus.READ_HOLDING,0,1)
+        finally:
+            print('P11 total_response_seconds=%.3f'%(time.monotonic()-start),flush=True)
+            client.close(); worker.join(3); listener.close()

+    def test_p15_model_csv_replay_independent_probability(self):

+            features=[mean,math.sqrt(sum((v-mean)**2 for v in x)/(n-1)),max(x),
+                      sum((i-(n-1)/2)*v for i,v in enumerate(x))/sum((i-(n-1)/2)**2 for i in range(n)),

+            for name,value in zip(anomaly.FEATURES,features):
+                z+=(value-float(model['mean',name]))/float(model['scale',name])*float(model['weight',name])
+            probability=1/(1+math.exp(-z)); error=abs(probability-float(row['p'])); worst=max(worst,error)
